use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::Value;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
#[serde(tag = "action", rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum AgentAction {
    #[serde(alias = "ReadFile")] ReadFile { path: String },
    #[serde(alias = "WriteFile")] WriteFile { path: String, content: String },
    #[serde(alias = "PatchFile")] PatchFile { path: String, search: String, replace: String },
    #[serde(alias = "ExecuteCommand")] ExecuteCommand { command: String },
    #[serde(alias = "Message")] Message { message: String },
    
    #[serde(alias = "GenerateReport")]
    GenerateReport { 
        #[serde(flatten)] data: Value 
    },
    
    // THE LIQUID CATCH-ALL
    #[serde(other)]
    SovereignDirective,
}

impl AgentAction {
    pub fn extract_and_parse(raw_response: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentAction>, String> {
        let unescaped = raw_response.replace("&quot;", "\"");
        
        let start = unescaped.find("[{").or_else(|| unescaped.find("[ {"));
        let end = unescaped.rfind(']');
        
        let json_str = match (start, end) {
            (Some(s), Some(e)) if s < e => &unescaped[s..=e],
            _ => return Err("No actionable logic array found.".into()),
        };

        // 1. Parse into a raw Value array
        let val_array: Vec<Value> = serde_json::from_str(json_str.trim())
            .map_err(|e| format!("JSON syntax error: {}", e))?;

        // 2. Liquid Hoisting & Shape-Shifting
        let mut actions = Vec::new();
        
        for mut val in val_array {
            if let Some(obj) = val.as_object_mut() {
                
                // SUTURE: Detect and repair External Tagging
                // Converts {"Message": {"message": "..."}} -> {"action": "Message", "message": "..."}
                let keys: Vec<String> = obj.keys().cloned().collect();
                if keys.len() == 1 && keys[0] != "action" {
                    let variant_name = keys[0].clone();
                    if let Some(inner_val) = obj.remove(&variant_name) {
                        if let Some(inner_obj) = inner_val.as_object() {
                            for (k, v) in inner_obj { obj.insert(k.clone(), v.clone()); }
                        } else {
                            // If the payload isn't an object, shove it into data
                            obj.insert("data".to_string(), inner_val);
                        }
                        obj.insert("action".to_string(), Value::String(variant_name));
                    }
                }

                // Flatten common nesting keys (including 'data' if the AI wrapped it unnecessarily)
                for key in ["parameters", "args", "details", "data"] {
                    if let Some(nested) = obj.remove(key) {
                        if let Some(n_obj) = nested.as_object() {
                            for (k, v) in n_obj { obj.insert(k.clone(), v.clone()); }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Route unrecognized actions to the catch-all
                let action_name = obj.get("action").and_then(|a| a.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string());
                if let Some(name) = action_name {
                    let core_actions = [
                        "read_file", "ReadFile", 
                        "write_file", "WriteFile", 
                        "patch_file", "PatchFile",
                        "execute_command", "ExecuteCommand", 
                        "message", "Message",
                        "generate_report", "GenerateReport"
                    ];
                    
                    if !core_actions.contains(&name.as_str()) {
                        obj.insert("action".to_string(), serde_json::json!("generate_report"));
                        obj.insert("original_action_name".to_string(), serde_json::json!(name));
                    }
                }
            }
            
            // 3. Attempt mapping
            match serde_json::from_value::<AgentAction>(val.clone()) {
                Ok(action) => actions.push(action),
                Err(e) => println!("\x1b[33m[SUTURE WARNING]: Failed to map fragment: {}\x1b[0m", e),
            }
        }

        if actions.is_empty() {
            Err("Failed to parse any valid actions from the stream.".into())
        } else {
            Ok(actions)
        }
    }
}

pub struct SwarmUnit {
    pub id: u32,
    pub sector: String,
    pub active: bool,
}

pub fn spawn_swarm(count: u32) -> Vec<SwarmUnit> {
    let mut swarm = Vec::new();
    
    for i in 1..=count {
        let sector = match i {
            1 => "Main/Alloc".to_string(),
            2 => "Server/Network".to_string(),
            3 => "Lazarus/Pulse".to_string(),
            _ => "General Maintenance".to_string(),
        };

        swarm.push(SwarmUnit {
            id: i,
            sector,
            active: true,
        });
    }
    
    swarm
}

use crate::neural_agent::{MicroAgent, ContextPacket};
use crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct RiskReport {
    pub risk_score: f32,
    pub logic_flaws: Vec<String>,
    pub recommendation: String,
    pub can_proceed: bool,
}

pub struct ArbiterAgent {
    pub agent: Arc<MicroAgent>,
    pub orchestrator: Option<Arc<Orchestrator>>,
}

impl ArbiterAgent {
    pub fn new(agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, orchestrator: Option<Arc<Orchestrator>>) -> Self {
        Self { agent, orchestrator }
    }

    pub async fn analyze_directive(&self, api_key: &str, directive: &str) -> Result<RiskReport, NexusError> {
        let system_prompt = "You are the NEXUS ARBITER. \
            Analyze risk and output ONLY valid JSON in this exact shape: \
            {\"risk_score\": float 0.0-1.0, \"logic_flaws\": [], \"recommendation\": \"...\", \"can_proceed\": bool}";

        let ctx = ContextPacket {
            system_prompt: Some(system_prompt.to_string()),
            ..Default::default()
        };

        let client = reqwest::Client::new();

        let (response, _) = self.agent.prepare_and_run(&client, api_key, directive, ctx, 0.3)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::NeuralLinkSevered(e.to_string()))?;

        // More robust JSON parsing with fallback
        let report: RiskReport = serde_json::from_str(&response)
            .or_else(|_| serde_json::from_str(&format!("{{ \"risk_score\": 0.9, \"logic_flaws\": [\"Parse failed\"], \"recommendation\": \"{}\", \"can_proceed\": false }}", response.trim())))
            .unwrap_or(RiskReport {
                risk_score: 1.0,
                logic_flaws: vec!["JSON Parse Error".into()],
                recommendation: "ABORT: Neural Logic Failure".into(),
                can_proceed: false,
            });

        Ok(report)
    }
}

use crate::server::AppState;

pub fn router() -> Router<Arc<AppState>> {
    Router::new()
        .route("/api/ast/summary", get(summary))
        .route("/api/ast/graph", get(graph))
        .route("/api/ast/complexity", get(complexity))
        .route("/api/ast/smells", get(smells))
}

async fn summary() -> impl IntoResponse { serve_json(".nexus_ast/ast_summary.json") }
async fn graph() -> impl IntoResponse { serve_json(".nexus_ast/symbol_graph.json") }
async fn complexity() -> impl IntoResponse { serve_json(".nexus_ast/complexity.json") }
async fn smells() -> impl IntoResponse { serve_json(".nexus_ast/smell_report.json") }

fn serve_json(path: &str) -> ([(HeaderName, &'static str); 1], String) {
    let data = fs::read_to_string(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| "{}".into());
    ([(axum::http::header::CONTENT_TYPE, "application/json")], data)
}

use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;
use std::env;
use std::fs;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // Manually load .env file into the process environment
    dotenvy::dotenv().ok();
    
    let api_key = env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY").expect("CRITICAL: GEMINI_API_KEY not found in .env");
    let client = Client::new();

    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    if args.len() < 3 {
        println!("Usage: analyst <file_path> <error_msg>");
        return Ok(());
    }

    let file_path = &args[1];
    let error_msg = &args[2];
    let code = fs::read_to_string(file_path)?;

    let prompt = format!(
        "FIX THIS RUST CODE. Error: {}\n\nCODE:\n{}\n\nOutput ONLY the corrected code. No explanations. No markdown blocks.",
        error_msg, code
    );

    let url = format!("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemma-3-27b-it:generateContent?key={}", api_key);
    
    let payload = json!({
        "contents": [{ "parts": [{ "text": prompt }] }]
    });

    println!(">> Sending to Google for healing...");
    let res = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await?;
    let body: serde_json::Value = res.json().await?;

    if let Some(fixed_code) = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
        // Strip any accidental markdown formatting the AI might add
        let clean_code = fixed_code.replace("```rust", "").replace("```", "").trim().to_string();
        fs::write(file_path, clean_code)?;
        println!(">> [SUCCESS] {} has been healed.", file_path);
    } else {
        println!(">> [FAILURE] API response was empty or malformed.");
        println!("Full Response: {:?}", body);
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn sanitize_payload(raw: &str) -> String {

       .replace("###", "---")
}

use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;
use std::process::Command;
use dotenvy::dotenv;

/// FIX: Replaced `Command::new("sh").arg("-c").arg("du ... && find ...")` with two
/// explicit, separate Command invocations. The previous sh -c pattern is safe with
/// static strings but becomes a shell injection vector the moment any variable is
/// interpolated. Explicit args eliminate that risk entirely and are easier to audit.
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    dotenv().ok();

    println!(">> [SCANNER] Mapping Infrastructure Metadata...");

    // 1a. Disk usage — explicit args, no shell interpolation
    let du_output = Command::new("du")
        .args(["-sh", "--exclude=target", "--exclude=.git", "--exclude=node_modules", "."])
        .output()?;
    let du_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&du_output.stdout);

    // 1b. File type inventory — explicit args
    let find_output = Command::new("find")
        .args([
            ".",
            "-maxdepth", "2",
            "-not", "-path", "*/.*",
            "-not", "-path", "./target/*",
            "-not", "-path", "./node_modules/*",
        ])
        .output()?;
    let find_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&find_output.stdout);

    let metadata = format!("=== DISK USAGE ===\n{}\n=== FILE INVENTORY ===\n{}", du_text, find_text);

    // 2. Conductor handshake
    let api_key = std::env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY")
        .expect("ERROR: GEMINI_API_KEY not found in .env");

    let url = format!(
        "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemma-3-27b-it:generateContent?key={}",
        api_key
    );

    let client = Client::new();
    let prompt = format!(
        "As the Nexus Infrastructure Auditor, analyze this build path metadata:\n{}\n\
        Verify that the models in /vault are correctly positioned for ARM64 inference. \
        Check for logical fragmentation or redundant dependencies.",
        metadata
    );

    let payload = json!({
        "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
        "generationConfig": { "temperature": 0.1 }
    });

    println!(">> [SCANNER] Sending Metadata to 27B Conductor for Analysis...");

    let resp = client.post(url).json(&payload).send().await?;
    let body: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await?;

    let analysis = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap_or("AUDIT_STALL: The Conductor did not return a report.");

    println!("\n>> [AUDIT REPORT - 15th LAYER]:\n{}", analysis);

    Ok(())
}

use std::env;
use std::fs;
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    // FIX: Use dotenvy consistently with all other binaries.
    dotenvy::dotenv().ok();

    // FIX: Use splitn(2, '=') so base64 keys containing '=' are not truncated.
    let api_key = env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY").unwrap_or_else(|_| {
        let env_file = fs::read_to_string(".env").unwrap_or_default();
        env_file
            .lines()
            .find(|l| l.starts_with("GEMINI_API_KEY="))
            .and_then(|l| l.splitn(2, '=').nth(1))
            .map(|v| v.trim().to_string())
            .expect("CRITICAL: GEMINI_API_KEY missing from environment and .env")
    });

    // Gather the trauma data
    let code = fs::read_to_string("src/main.rs").unwrap_or_default();
    let crash = fs::read_to_string("crash_report.txt").unwrap_or_default();

    let prompt = format!(
        "You are NEXUS, a sovereign AI engineer.\nPROTOCOL:\n1. Output FULL files inside ```rust ... ``` blocks.\n2. Fix the fatal compiler error.\n\n[CRASH LOG]\n{}\n\n[src/main.rs]\n{}",
        crash, code
    );

    let url = format!(
        "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemma-3-27b-it:generateContent?key={}",
        api_key
    );
    let payload = json!({
        "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
        "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.1, "maxOutputTokens": 4096}
    });

    println!(">> [SENTRY-BRAIN] Uplink established. Analyzing crash data...");

    let client = Client::new();
    let res: Value = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await?.json().await?;

    if let Some(text) = res["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
        let patch = if text.contains("```rust") {
            text.split("```rust").nth(1).unwrap_or("").split("```").next().unwrap_or("").trim()
        } else if text.contains("```") {
            text.split("```").nth(1).unwrap_or("").split("```").next().unwrap_or("").trim()
        } else {
            text
        };

        if !patch.is_empty() {
            fs::write("src/main.rs", patch)?;
            println!(">> [SENTRY-BRAIN] Patch synthesized and applied to src/main.rs.");
        } else {
            println!(">> [SENTRY-BRAIN] Failed to extract patch signature.");
        }
    }

    Ok(())
}

use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::fs;
use std::sync::Arc;
use walkdir::WalkDir;
use regex::Regex;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use chrono;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct AtlasEntry {
    pub name: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub signature: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Default)]
pub struct ProjectAtlas {
    pub entries: Vec<AtlasEntry>,
    pub timestamp: i64,
}

static CACHED_ATLAS: Lazy<Arc<RwLock<ProjectAtlas>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Arc::new(RwLock::new(ProjectAtlas::default())));

pub struct KnowledgeBroker;

impl KnowledgeBroker {
    pub async fn refresh_atlas() {
        let mut entries = Vec::new();
        let re_fn = Regex::new(r"pub (?:async )?fn ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)").unwrap();

        if let Ok(it) = WalkDir::new("src")
            .into_iter()
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
        {
            for entry in it
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|e| e.path().extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "rs"))
            {
                let path = entry.path().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(entry.path()) {
                    for cap in re_fn.captures_iter(&content) {
                        entries.push(AtlasEntry {
                            name: cap[1].to_string(),
                            kind: "function".into(),
                            path: path.clone(),
                            signature: cap[0].to_string(),
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let mut cache = CACHED_ATLAS.write().await;
        *cache = ProjectAtlas {
            entries,
            timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp(),
        };
    }

    pub async fn get_atlas() -> ProjectAtlas {
        let cache = CACHED_ATLAS.read().await;
        (*cache).clone()
    }

    pub async fn get_compressed_context() -> String {
        let cache = CACHED_ATLAS.read().await;
        let mut summary = String::from("PROJECT_ATLAS:\n");
        for e in cache.entries.iter().take(30) {
            summary.push_str(&format!("[{}] {} in {}\n", e.kind, e.name, e.path));
        }
        summary
    }
}

use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use std::path::PathBuf;

/// NEXUS SINGULARITY CLI — v1.5.0
#[derive(Parser, Debug)]
#[command(name = "nexus", about = "NEXUS SOVEREIGN INTERFACE", disable_help_subcommand = true)]
pub struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub command: Commands,
}

#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]
pub enum Commands {
    /// build: Orchestrates a target build.
    Build { #[arg(default_value = ".")] path: PathBuf },
    /// heal: Initiates neural repair on a specific file.
    Heal { #[arg(required = true)] file: PathBuf },
    /// open: Maps a file into the cortical workspace.
    Open { #[arg(required = true)] file: PathBuf },
    /// status: Polls system hardware resonance.
    Status,
    /// diff: Computes delta between two logic strands.
    Diff { #[arg(required = true)] original: PathBuf, #[arg(required = true)] against: PathBuf },
    /// restore: Reverts system state to a Lazarus snapshot.
    Restore { #[arg(required = true)] hash: String },
    /// close: Flushes a file from the workspace.
    Close { #[arg(required = true)] file: PathBuf },
}

// === SUTURE: EXPOSED CONTEXT INJECTOR FOR CLI & SERVER ===
pub fn inject_workspace_dna(cmd: &str) -> String {
    let lower_cmd = cmd.to_lowercase();
    let mut final_cmd = cmd.to_string();

    // If the user asks for a broad audit or review, attach the workspace DNA
    if lower_cmd.contains("audit") || lower_cmd.contains("review") || lower_cmd.contains("scan") {
        println!("\x1b[36m>> [CLI_INJECTOR] Broad analysis detected. Attaching local workspace DNA...\x1b[0m");
        let mut context = String::from("\n\n--- [SYSTEM WORKSPACE DNA] ---\n");
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir("src") {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                    if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                        let preview = if content.len() > 15000 { &content[..15000] } else { &content };
                        context.push_str(&format!("\n// === FILE: {} ===\n{}\n", path.display(), preview));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Also inject Cargo.toml if scanning for dependencies
        if lower_cmd.contains("cargo.toml") || lower_cmd.contains("depend") {
            if let Ok(cargo) = std::fs::read_to_string("Cargo.toml") {
                context.push_str(&format!("\n// === FILE: Cargo.toml ===\n{}\n", cargo));
            }
        }

        final_cmd.push_str(&context);
    }
    final_cmd
}

// === SUTURE: AUTONOMIC MUSCLE DETECTION ===
pub enum HostMuscle {
    MotorolaTermux,
    ChromebookCrostini,
    GenericARM64,
}

pub fn detect_host_muscle() -> HostMuscle {
    // Termux natively exports the PREFIX environment variable
    if std::env::var("PREFIX").unwrap_or_default().contains("com.termux") {
        return HostMuscle::MotorolaTermux;
    }
    
    // Chromebook/Crostini Linux kernels carry specific generic signatures
    if let Ok(kernel) = std::fs::read_to_string("/proc/version") {
        let k_lower = kernel.to_lowercase();
        if k_lower.contains("chrome") || k_lower.contains("cros") || k_lower.contains("penguin") {
            return HostMuscle::ChromebookCrostini;
        }
    }
    
    HostMuscle::GenericARM64
}

pub fn get_muscle_string(muscle: &HostMuscle) -> &'static str {
    match muscle {
        HostMuscle::MotorolaTermux => "MOTOROLA_EDGE [TERMUX SANDBOX]",
        HostMuscle::ChromebookCrostini => "CHROMEBOOK [NATIVE LINUX]",
        HostMuscle::GenericARM64 => "UNKNOWN [GENERIC ARM64]",
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor;

pub async fn execute_allowed_command(_m: &SystemMonitor, cmd: &str) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    let allowed = ["cargo", "npm", "ls", "echo", "grep", "find"];
    let parts: Vec<&str> = cmd.split_whitespace().collect();
    
    if parts.is_empty() { return Err("Empty command".into()); }
    
    if !allowed.contains(&parts[0]) {
        return Err(format!("SECURITY: Command '{}' is not in the Sovereign Whitelist.", parts[0]));
    }
    
    let output = Command::new(parts[0])
        .args(&parts[1..])
        .output()
        .map_err(|e| format!("IO Error: {}", e))?;
        
    Ok(serde_json::json!({
        "success": output.status.success(),
        "stdout": String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
        "stderr": String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
    }))
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/src/src/component_runner.rs]

use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::executor::Executor;
use bitflags::bitflags;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, mpsc, oneshot};

bitflags! {
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
    pub struct Capabilities: u32 {
        const READ_FS      = 0b0000_0001;
        const WRITE_FS     = 0b0000_0010;
        const NETWORK      = 0b0000_0100;
        const SPAWN_DRONE  = 0b0000_1000;
        const SYSTEM_EXEC  = 0b0001_0000;
        const MEMORY_OPS   = 0b0010_0000;
        const VISION       = 0b0100_0000;
        const ZIG_FFI      = 0b1000_0000;
        const ALL          = 0b1111_1111;
    }
}

pub enum ComponentMessage {
    ExecuteActions {
        actions: Vec<AgentAction>,
        reply: oneshot::Sender<Result<Vec<String>, NexusError>>,
    },
    ZigFfiCall {
        op: Box<dyn FnOnce() -> Result<String, String> + Send + 'static>,
        reply: oneshot::Sender<Result<String, NexusError>>,
    },
    Shutdown,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct AgentHandle {
    pub tx: mpsc::Sender<ComponentMessage>,
    pub id: String,
    pub capabilities: Capabilities,
}

impl AgentHandle {
    pub async fn execute_actions(&self, actions: Vec<AgentAction>) -> Result<Vec<String>, NexusError> {
        let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = oneshot::channel();
        let _ = self.tx.send(ComponentMessage::ExecuteActions { actions, reply: reply_tx }).await;
        reply_rx.await.map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("Actor reply closed".into()))?
    }

    pub async fn zig_ffi_call<F>(&self, op: F) -> Result<String, NexusError>
    where
        F: FnOnce() -> Result<String, String> + Send + 'static,
    {
        let (reply_tx, reply_rx) = oneshot::channel();
        let _ = self.tx.send(ComponentMessage::ZigFfiCall { op: Box::new(op), reply: reply_tx }).await;
        reply_rx.await.map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("Actor reply closed".into()))?
    }
}

pub enum SupervisionEvent {
    ChildFailed { id: String, error: String },
    ChildShutdown { id: String },
}

pub struct ActorSupervisor {
    _children: Vec<AgentHandle>,
    _lifecycle_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
}

impl ActorSupervisor {
    pub fn new(lifecycle_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> (Self, mpsc::Receiver<SupervisionEvent>) {
        let (_sup_tx, sup_rx) = mpsc::channel(32);
        let supervisor = Self {
            _children: Vec::new(),
            _lifecycle_tx: lifecycle_tx,
        };
        (supervisor, sup_rx)
    }

    pub fn spawn_child(
        &mut self,
        id: &str,
        caps: Capabilities,
        agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
        lifecycle_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    ) -> AgentHandle {
        let handle = AgentComponent::spawn(id, caps, agent, lifecycle_tx);
        self._children.push(handle.clone());
        handle
    }

    pub async fn monitor(&self, mut rx: mpsc::Receiver<SupervisionEvent>) {
        while let Some(event) = rx.recv().await {
            match event {
                SupervisionEvent::ChildFailed { id, error } => {
                    println!(">> [SUPERVISOR] Child {} failed: {}. Restarting...", id, error);
                }
                SupervisionEvent::ChildShutdown { id } => {
                    println!(">> [SUPERVISOR] Child {} shutdown cleanly.", id);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub struct AgentComponent {
    pub id: String,
    pub capabilities: Capabilities,
    pub agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
    pub lifecycle_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    pub mailbox: mpsc::Receiver<ComponentMessage>,
    pub self_tx: mpsc::Sender<ComponentMessage>,
}

impl AgentComponent {
    pub fn spawn(
        id: &str,
        caps: Capabilities,
        agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
        lifecycle_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
    ) -> AgentHandle {
        let (tx, rx) = mpsc::channel(32);
        let actor = Self {
            id: id.to_string(),
            capabilities: caps,
            agent,
            lifecycle_tx,
            mailbox: rx,
            self_tx: tx.clone(),
        };
        tokio::spawn(actor.run());
        AgentHandle { tx, id: id.to_string(), capabilities: caps }
    }

    async fn run(mut self) {
        while let Some(msg) = self.mailbox.recv().await {
            match msg {
                ComponentMessage::ExecuteActions { actions, reply } => {
                    let result = Executor::execute_handle(&self.to_handle(), actions).await;
                    let _ = reply.send(result);
                }
                ComponentMessage::ZigFfiCall { op, reply } => {
                    let result = if self.capabilities.contains(Capabilities::ZIG_FFI) {
                        op().map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("ZIG_FFI: {}", e)))
                    } else {
                        Err(NexusError::SecurityViolation { message: format!("{} lacks ZIG_FFI", self.id), cvss: 7.5 })
                    };
                    let _ = reply.send(result);
                }
                ComponentMessage::Shutdown => break,
            }
        }
    }

    fn to_handle(&self) -> AgentHandle {
        AgentHandle {
            tx: self.self_tx.clone(),
            id: self.id.clone(),
            capabilities: self.capabilities,
        }
    }
}

use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;

pub struct DiffEngine;

impl DiffEngine {
    pub fn apply(original: &str, search: &str, replace: &str) -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        let clean_search = search.trim();
        if clean_search.is_empty() { return Ok(original.to_string()); }
        
        // STRICT PROTOCOL: Exact match only to prevent fuzzy data corruption
        if original.contains(search) { 
            return Ok(original.replace(search, replace)); 
        }

        Err(NexusError::Patch("PATTERN_NOT_FOUND: Could not locate exact search string in file.".into()))
    }

    pub fn unified_diff(_old: &str, _new: &str, path: &str) -> String {
        format!("--- a/{}\n+++ b/{}\n[MODIFICATION DETECTED]", path, path)
    }
}

use chrono::Utc;
use std::path::Path;

pub struct Hiram {
    pub integrity: i32,
    pub last_verified: Option<i64>,
    pub verification_interval: i64, 
}

impl Hiram {
    pub fn new(verification_interval: i64) -> Self {
        Self { integrity: 100, last_verified: None, verification_interval }
    }

    pub fn verify(&mut self) {
        let now = Utc::now().timestamp();
        if let Some(lv) = self.last_verified {
            if now - lv < self.verification_interval { return; }
        }

        // Real Integrity Check: Do the vital organs exist?
        let missions_ok = Path::new("missions").exists();
        let claims_ok = Path::new("claims").exists();

        if !missions_ok || !claims_ok {
            self.integrity -= 10;
            println!(">> [KERNEL] WARNING: System folders missing! Integrity: {}%", self.integrity);
        } else if self.integrity < 100 {
            self.integrity += 1;
        }

        println!(">> [KERNEL] Integrity Check: {}%", self.integrity);
        self.last_verified = Some(now);
    }
}

        }
        Ok(())
    }

use std::process::Command;
use serde::Serialize;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use crate::resonator::ResonatorCore; // Import the Zig Interface

#[derive(Clone, Serialize, Debug)]
pub struct AgentStatus {
    pub id: u32,
    pub name: String,
    pub target: String,
    pub state: String,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct NanoSwarm {
    tx: broadcast::Sender<AgentStatus>,
}

impl NanoSwarm {
    pub fn new(tx: broadcast::Sender<AgentStatus>) -> Self {
        Self { tx }
    }

    pub fn get_roster(&self) -> String {
        "- SENTINEL (Rust Compiler)\n- INQUISITOR (Python Validator)".to_string()
    }

    pub fn trigger_diagnostics(&self, file_path: String) {
        let tx = self.tx.clone();
        
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            if file_path.ends_with(".rs") {
                // 1. Notify Web UI (WebSocket)
                let _ = tx.send(AgentStatus { id: 1, name: "SENTINEL".into(), target: "Compiling...".into(), state: "active".into() });
                
                // 2. Notify Zig/NPU (Hardware Pulse)
                ResonatorCore::sync_agent(1, "active");

                let output = Command::new("cargo").arg("check").output();
                match output {
                    Ok(out) if out.status.success() => {
                        let _ = tx.send(AgentStatus { id: 1, name: "SENTINEL".into(), target: "SECURE".into(), state: "idle".into() });
                        ResonatorCore::sync_agent(1, "idle");
                    },
                    _ => {
                        let _ = tx.send(AgentStatus { id: 1, name: "SENTINEL".into(), target: "COMPILE FAIL".into(), state: "alert".into() });
                        ResonatorCore::sync_agent(1, "alert"); 
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
}

use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::component_runner::AgentHandle;
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender;
use comfy_table::{Table, Cell, Color, Attribute, presets::UTF8_FULL_CONDENSED};
use regex::Regex;
use std::process::Command;

pub struct Executor;

impl Executor {
    pub async fn execute_handle(
        _handle: &AgentHandle,
        actions: Vec<AgentAction>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, NexusError> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();
        for action in actions {
            match action {
                AgentAction::Message { message } => results.push(format!(">> [MSG]: {}", message)),
                _ => results.push("!! [AGENT]: Legacy directive logged.".into()),
            }
        }
        Ok(results)
    }

    pub async fn execute_swarm_json(
        json_text: &str, 
        tx: &Sender<String>
    ) -> Result<(), NexusError> {
        let re = Regex::new(r"(?s)```json\s*(.*?)\s*```").unwrap_or_else(|_| Regex::new("").unwrap());
        
        let json_payload = if let Some(caps) = re.captures(json_text) {
            caps.get(1).map_or(json_text, |m| m.as_str())
        } else {
            let start = json_text.find('[').unwrap_or(0);
            let end = json_text.rfind(']').unwrap_or(json_text.len() - 1);
            if start < end { &json_text[start..=end] } else { json_text }
        };

        if let Ok(actions) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<Value>>(json_payload) {
            let msg = ">> [EXECUTOR] Action Matrix intercepted. Mapping execution topology...";
            println!("\x1b[32m{}\x1b[0m", msg);
            let _ = tx.send(msg.to_string());
            
            let mut table = Table::new();
            table.load_preset(UTF8_FULL_CONDENSED);
            table.set_header(vec![
                Cell::new("OPCODE").add_attribute(Attribute::Bold).fg(Color::Cyan),
                Cell::new("TARGET").add_attribute(Attribute::Bold).fg(Color::Magenta),
                Cell::new("PAYLOAD / DIAGNOSTIC DATA").add_attribute(Attribute::Bold).fg(Color::DarkGrey),
            ]);

            for action in actions {
                let op = action.get("action").or_else(|| action.get("op")).or_else(|| action.get("task")).and_then(|a| a.as_str()).unwrap_or("UNKNOWN").to_lowercase();
                let target = action.get("target").or_else(|| action.get("file")).or_else(|| action.get("resource")).and_then(|a| a.as_str()).unwrap_or("GLOBAL");
                
                let mut details = action.clone();
                if let Some(obj) = details.as_object_mut() {
                    obj.remove("action"); obj.remove("op"); obj.remove("task");
                    obj.remove("target"); obj.remove("file"); obj.remove("resource");
                }
                
                let details_str = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&details).unwrap_or_default();
                table.add_row(vec![Cell::new(&op).fg(Color::Green), Cell::new(target).fg(Color::Yellow), Cell::new(details_str.clone())]);
                
                let _ = tx.send(format!(">> [EXECUTOR] {} -> {}", op, target));

                let cmd = details.get("command")
                    .or_else(|| details.get("cmd"))
                    .or_else(|| details.get("bash_command"))
                    .or_else(|| details.get("bash-command"))
                    .or_else(|| details.get("payload").and_then(|p| p.get("command")))
                    .or_else(|| details.get("payload").and_then(|p| p.get("bash_command")))
                    .or_else(|| details.get("payload").and_then(|p| p.get("bash-command")))
                    .and_then(|c| c.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("");

                let is_mutating_op = matches!(op.as_str(), "bash" | "execute_bash" | "shell_execute" | "write_file" | "patch" | "generate_restore_cmd" | "restore_src");
                if is_mutating_op || (!cmd.is_empty() && (cmd.contains("rm ") || cmd.contains("cp ") || cmd.contains("tar "))) {
                    let msg = ">> [LAZARUS PROTOCOL] Mutating action detected. Securing DNA snapshot...";
                    println!("\x1b[33m{}\x1b[0m", msg);
                    let _ = tx.send(msg.to_string());
                    
                    let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs();
                    let backup_cmd = format!("mkdir -p .lazarus_vault/{} && cp -r src Cargo.toml .lazarus_vault/{}/ 2>/dev/null || true", timestamp, timestamp);
                    let _ = Command::new("sh").args(["-c", &backup_cmd]).output();
                    println!("\x1b[32m>> [LAZARUS PROTOCOL] Snapshot {} secured.\x1b[0m", timestamp);
                }

                if !cmd.is_empty() {
                    println!("\n\x1b[33m>> [SYS_EXEC] Spawning shell process: {}\x1b[0m", cmd);
                    match Command::new("sh").args(["-c", cmd]).output() {
                        Ok(output) => {
                            let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
                            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
                            if !stdout.is_empty() { println!("\x1b[32m{}\x1b[0m", stdout.trim()); }
                            if !stderr.is_empty() { println!("\x1b[31m{}\x1b[0m", stderr.trim()); }
                            println!("\x1b[33m>> [SYS_EXEC] Process Terminated.\x1b[0m\n");
                        }
                        Err(e) => println!("\x1b[31m!! [SYS_EXEC FAULT] {}\x1b[0m", e),
                    }
                }
            }
            println!("\n{}", table);
        } else {
            println!("\x1b[31m!! [EXECUTOR FAULT] Failed to parse JSON matrix.\x1b[0m\n{}", json_text);
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

use crate::neural_agent::{ContextPacket, MicroAgent};
use std::process::Command;

pub async fn fix_ui(
    force: bool,
    agent: &MicroAgent,
    client: &reqwest::Client,
    api_key: &str,
) {
    println!(">> [AUTOFIX] Correlating UI faults with Gemma-3...");

    let plan_prompt = format!(
        "Fix the Svelte frontend. Force mode: {}. Provide a 3-step repair plan.",
        force
    );

    let ctx = ContextPacket::default();
    
    if let Ok((plan, _)) = agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &plan_prompt, ctx, 0.5).await {
        println!("\n\x1b[36m[REPAIR PLAN]\x1b[0m\n{}", plan);
    }

    // AUDITOR FIX: Explicit Status Checking (No more blind execution)
    if force {
        println!("   • Force: Purging artifacts...");
        let _ = Command::new("rm").args(["-rf", "ui/node_modules", "ui/dist"]).status();
    }
    
    println!("   • Ingesting dependencies...");
    let install_status = Command::new("npm").current_dir("ui").arg("install").status();
    
    if let Ok(s) = install_status {
        if s.success() {
            println!("   • Integrating UI strands...");
            let build_status = Command::new("npm").current_dir("ui").args(["run", "build"]).status();
            if let Ok(bs) = build_status {
                if bs.success() {
                    println!("\x1b[32m>> [SUCCESS] UI Zenith Reached.\x1b[0m");
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    eprintln!("\x1b[31m!! [CRITICAL] UI Repair failed. Manual triage required.\x1b[0m");
}

use std::process::Command;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc, Duration};

pub fn check_cluster_sync() -> bool {
    let output = Command::new("gh")
        .args(&["issue", "view", "1", "--json", "comments", "-q", ".comments[-1].createdAt"])
        .output();

    if let Ok(out) = output {
        let timestamp_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
        if let Ok(last_heartbeat) = timestamp_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {
            let drift = Utc::now() - last_heartbeat;
            return drift < Duration::try_minutes(5).unwrap();
        }
    }
    false
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/src/src/hive_mind.rs]

use anyhow::Result;
use serde_json::json;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;

/// HiveMind now uses the existing tokio broadcast bus instead of Redis.
/// Saves ~50MB RAM and removes the Redis process dependency entirely.
pub struct HiveMind {
    tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
}

impl HiveMind {
    pub fn new(tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Self {
        Self { tx }
    }

    pub async fn dispatch_task(&self, drone: &str, task: &str, params: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let payload = json!({
            "type": "HIVE_DISPATCH",
            "drone": drone,
            "task": task,
            "params": params,
            "timestamp": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339()
        });

        self.tx.send(payload.to_string())
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Broadcast send failed: {}", e))?;

        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver<String> {
        self.tx.subscribe()

use std::process::Command;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;

pub struct Inquisitor;

impl Inquisitor {
    /// audit_ui: Runs the actual Svelte build and captures the REAL error.
    pub fn audit_ui() -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        println!("\x1b[33m>> [INQUISITOR] Executing UI Build Interrogation...\x1b[0m");
        
        // We use output() instead of status() to capture the text
        let output = Command::new("npm")
            .args(["run", "build"])
            .current_dir("ui")
            .output()
            .map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("NPM binary not found in path".into()))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            Ok("NOMINAL".into())
        } else {
            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string();
            let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string();
            // Combine both because some builders output errors to stdout
            Ok(format!("STDOUT:\n{}\nSTDERR:\n{}", stdout, stderr))
        }
    }

    pub fn audit_backend() -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        let output = Command::new("cargo")
            .args(["check"])
            .output()
            .map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("Cargo not found".into()))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            Ok("NOMINAL".into())
        } else {
            Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string())
        }
    }
}

                governor.apply_cooldown().await;
                let vitals = state.monitor.get_vitals();
                // UPGRADE: Fixed logic error. cpu_load is a fraction, so it should be < 0.15, not < 15.0
                if vitals.cpu_load < 0.15 && governor.get_state() == crate::thermal_governor::CoolingState::Normal {

                }
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
            }
        });
    }
}

use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use serde_json::Value;
use regex::Regex;

pub struct NeuralParser;

impl NeuralParser {
    pub fn extract_actions(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentAction>, NexusError> {
        let mut actions = Vec::new();
        
        // 1. Remove Sovereign Thought Blocks (<|think|>, <|thought|>, <|channel|>)
        let thought_re = Regex::new(r"(?s)<\|(?:think|thought|channel)>.*?<\|(?:end|channel)\|?>").unwrap();
        let stripped_text = thought_re.replace_all(text, "");
        
        // 2. Revert HTML entities
        let unescaped_text = stripped_text.replace("&quot;", "\"").replace("&amp;", "&");
        
        // 3. Locate the outermost array [ ... ]
        if let (Some(start), Some(end)) = (unescaped_text.find('['), unescaped_text.rfind(']')) {
            if start < end {
                let array_str = &unescaped_text[start..=end];
                
                // Attempt direct array parsing
                if let Ok(batch) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<AgentAction>>(array_str) {
                    return Ok(batch);
                }
                
                // Fallback: Try parsing as generic Value array to filter valid actions
                if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(array_str) {
                    if let Some(arr) = val.as_array() {
                        for item in arr {
                            if let Ok(action) = serde_json::from_value::<AgentAction>(item.clone()) {
                                actions.push(action);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if actions.is_empty() {
            Err(NexusError::Other("DNA_TRANSLATION_FAILURE: Bridge could not bind actions to schema.".into()))
        } else {
            Ok(actions)
        }
    }
}

use std::fmt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Severity {
    Critical, // CVSS 9.0-10.0
    High,     // CVSS 7.0-8.9
    Medium,   // CVSS 4.0-6.9
    Low,      // CVSS 0.1-3.9
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum KernelError {
    VmoCloneFailed { parent: u32, size: usize },
    VmarMapFailed { vmar_handle: u32, size: usize },
    InvalidHandle(u32),
    AlignmentAnomaly { address: usize },
    SecurityViolation { message: String, cvss: f32 },
}

impl KernelError {
    pub fn severity(&self) -> Severity {
        match self {
            Self::SecurityViolation { cvss, .. } => {
                if *cvss >= 9.0 { Severity::Critical }
                else if *cvss >= 7.0 { Severity::High }
                else { Severity::Medium }
            },
            Self::VmarMapFailed { .. } => Severity::High,
            Self::VmoCloneFailed { .. } => Severity::High,
            Self::AlignmentAnomaly { .. } => Severity::Medium,
            Self::InvalidHandle(_) => Severity::Low,
        }
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for KernelError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let label = match self.severity() {
            Severity::Critical => "![CRITICAL]!",
            Severity::High => "[HIGH]",
            Severity::Medium => "[MEDIUM]",
            Severity::Low => "[LOW]",
        };
        match self {
            Self::VmoCloneFailed { parent, size } => write!(f, "{} VMO_CLONE_FAIL: parent={} size={}", label, parent, size),
            Self::VmarMapFailed { vmar_handle, size } => write!(f, "{} VMAR_MAP_FAIL: handle=0x{:x} size={}", label, vmar_handle, size),
            Self::InvalidHandle(h) => write!(f, "{} INVALID_HANDLE: 0x{:x}", label, h),
            Self::AlignmentAnomaly { address } => write!(f, "{} ALIGN_FAIL: address=0x{:x}", label, address),
            Self::SecurityViolation { message, cvss } => write!(f, "{} SECURITY: {} (CVSS: {:.1})", label, message, cvss),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for KernelError {}

pub const ROOT_VMAR_HANDLE: u32 = 0;
pub const MAX_REGION_SIZE: usize = 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const ZX_VM_PERM_READ: u32 = 1 << 1;
pub const ZX_VM_PERM_WRITE: u32 = 1 << 2;
pub const ZX_VM_MAP_RANGE: u32 = 1 << 4;

pub trait KernelOps: Send + Sync {
    fn vmo_clone(&self, parent: u32, size: usize) -> u32;
    fn vmar_map(&self, vmar: u32, options: u32, vmo: u32, size: usize) -> *mut u8;
    fn handle_close(&self, handle: u32);
}

pub struct HardwareInterface;

impl KernelOps for HardwareInterface {
    fn vmo_clone(&self, parent: u32, size: usize) -> u32 {
        println!(">> [MOCK KERNEL] Cloning VMO parent {} with size {}", parent, size);
        parent + 1 
    }
    fn vmar_map(&self, vmar: u32, _options: u32, vmo: u32, size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        println!(">> [MOCK KERNEL] Mapping VMO {} to VMAR {} (Size: {})", vmo, vmar, size);
        std::ptr::null_mut() // Safe null pointer for testing
    }
    fn handle_close(&self, handle: u32) {
        println!(">> [MOCK KERNEL] Closing handle {}", handle);
    }
}

pub mod raw {
    pub unsafe fn nexus_vmar_map(_vmar: u32, _options: u32, _vmo: u32, _size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        std::ptr::null_mut()
    }
    pub unsafe fn nexus_vmo_clone(parent: u32, _size: usize) -> u32 {
        parent + 1
    }
    pub unsafe fn nexus_handle_close(_handle: u32) {}
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct VmarHandle(pub u32);

impl Default for VmarHandle {
    fn default() -> Self { Self(ROOT_VMAR_HANDLE) }
}

pub struct SafeBuffer {
    data: Vec<u8>,
    max_capacity: usize,
}

impl SafeBuffer {
    pub fn new(max_capacity: usize) -> Self {
        Self { data: Vec::with_capacity(max_capacity), max_capacity }
    }

    pub fn write_safe(&mut self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.data.len() + payload.len() > self.max_capacity {
            return Err("MEMORY FAULT: Buffer overflow prevented by strict bounds check.".into());
        }
        self.data.extend_from_slice(payload);
        Ok(())
    }
}

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;

pub const CACHE_LINE_SIZE: usize = 64;
pub const ALIGN_MASK: usize = CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1;

pub struct RealignmentEngine;

impl RealignmentEngine {
    /// check_alignment_fast: Deterministically verifies 64-byte boundaries.
    #[inline(always)]
    pub fn check_alignment_fast(address: *const u8) -> Result<(), KernelError> {
        let addr_val = address as usize;
        if (addr_val & ALIGN_MASK) == 0 {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(KernelError::AlignmentAnomaly { address: addr_val })
        }
    }
}

/// Standard alignment check to address CVSS 5.3 Alignment Anomaly
pub fn is_aligned(ptr: usize, align: usize) -> bool {
    if align == 0 || (align & (align - 1)) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ptr % align == 0
}

/// Secure wrapper for memory mapping offsets
pub fn validate_vmo_offset(offset: u64, size: u64, map_len: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
    if offset.checked_add(map_len).map_or(true, |end| end > size) {
        return Err("KERNEL_SECURITY: Out of bounds VMO mapping".to_string());
    }
    if !is_aligned(offset as usize, 4096) {
        return Err("KERNEL_SECURITY: Misaligned VMO mapping".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;
use crate::kernel::ffi::{self, ZX_VM_PERM_READ, ZX_VM_PERM_WRITE, ZX_VM_MAP_RANGE};
use crate::kernel::vmo::Vmo;
use std::ptr;

/// VirtualMemoryAddressRegion: Orchestrates address space mapping.
pub struct Vmar;

impl Vmar {
    /// map: Maps a VMO into the specified VMAR handle using centralized permissions.
    pub fn map(vmar_handle: u32, vmo: &Vmo) -> Result<*mut u8, KernelError> {
        let options = ZX_VM_PERM_READ | ZX_VM_PERM_WRITE | ZX_VM_MAP_RANGE;
        
        let addr = unsafe {
            ffi::raw::nexus_vmar_map(vmar_handle, options, vmo.handle, vmo.size)
        };

        if addr == ptr::null_mut() {
            Err(KernelError::VmarMapFailed { 
                vmar_handle,
                size: vmo.size 
            })
        } else {
            Ok(addr)
        }
    }
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/src/src/kernel/vmo.rs]

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;
use crate::kernel::ffi::KernelOps;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Vmo: Virtual Memory Object owning a kernel handle.
pub struct Vmo {
    pub handle: u32,
    pub size: usize,
    ops: Arc<dyn KernelOps>,
}

impl Vmo {
    /// clone: Generates a child VMO using the provided hardware interface.
    pub fn clone(ops: Arc<dyn KernelOps>, parent: u32, size: usize) -> Result<Self, KernelError> {
        if parent == 0 { return Err(KernelError::InvalidHandle(0)); }
        
        let handle = ops.vmo_clone(parent, size);
        if handle == 0 {
            Err(KernelError::VmoCloneFailed { parent, size })
        } else {
            Ok(Self { handle, size, ops })
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for Vmo {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.ops.handle_close(self.handle);
    }
}

use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use chrono::Utc;
use sha2::{Sha256, Digest};
use anyhow::{Result, Context};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Snapshot {
    pub timestamp: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub author: String,
    pub hash: String,
    pub backup_path: String,
}

pub struct LazarusVault;

impl LazarusVault {
    const MAX_HISTORY: usize = 50;

    pub fn list_snapshots() -> Result<VecDeque<Snapshot>> {
        let ledger_path = Path::new(".lazarus/ledger.json");
        if !ledger_path.exists() { return Ok(VecDeque::new()); }
        let data = fs::read_to_string(ledger_path).context("Vault Read Fault")?;
        serde_json::from_str(&data).context("DNA Corruption")
    }

    pub fn auto_snapshot(target: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let content = fs::read_to_string(target).unwrap_or_default();
        Self::seal_patch(target, &content, reason)
    }

    pub fn seal_patch(target: &str, content: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let root = Path::new(".lazarus/snapshots");
        fs::create_dir_all(root)?;

        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
        hasher.update(content);
        let hash = hasher.finalize().iter().map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b)).collect::<String>();

        let timestamp = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let backup_path = root.join(format!("{}.snap", Utc::now().timestamp_micros()));
        fs::write(&backup_path, content)?;
        
        let mut ledger = Self::list_snapshots().unwrap_or_default();
        if ledger.len() >= Self::MAX_HISTORY { ledger.pop_front(); }

        ledger.push_back(Snapshot {
            timestamp,
            path: target.to_string(),
            author: format!("AUTO: {}", reason),
            hash: hash.clone(),
            backup_path: backup_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
        });
        
        fs::write(".lazarus/ledger.json", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&ledger)?)?;
        Ok(hash)
    }

    pub fn restore_snapshot(hash_prefix: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let ledger = Self::list_snapshots()?;
        let target_snap = ledger.iter().find(|s| s.hash.starts_with(hash_prefix))
            .context("!! [VAULT] Snapshot hash not found.")?;

        if !Path::new(&target_snap.backup_path).exists() {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("!! [VAULT] Physical backup file missing."));
        }

        let safe_content = fs::read_to_string(&target_snap.backup_path)?;
        fs::write(&target_snap.path, safe_content)?;
        Ok(format!(">> [RESTORED] {} reverted to state {}", target_snap.path, hash_prefix))
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;

pub struct LocalLLM;

impl LocalLLM {
    pub fn new() -> Self { LocalLLM }

    /// Ephemeral Execution Protocol: Load -> Infer -> Drop RAM
    pub fn query_gemma_nano(&self, prompt: &str, model_path: &str) -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        println!("\x1b[35m>> [LOCAL_LLM] Allocating RAM for {}...\x1b[0m", model_path);
        
        // We use llama.cpp's CLI as a universal ARM64 execution wrapper.
        // We restrict context (-c 512) and output tokens (-n 128) to ensure 
        // the process completes in milliseconds and doesn't blow out the RAM.
        let output = Command::new("./vendor/llama.cpp/llama-cli")
            .args([
                "-m", model_path,
                "-p", prompt,
                "-n", "128", 
                "-c", "512",
                "--temp", "0.1",
                "--log-disable" // Ensure stdout only contains the AI's answer
            ])
            .output()
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("Failed to spawn local inference: {}", e)))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            let response = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string();
            println!("\x1b[35m>> [LOCAL_LLM] Inference complete. RAM flushed.\x1b[0m");
            Ok(response.trim().to_string())
        } else {
            let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
            Err(NexusError::Other(format!("Local GGUF Fault: {}", err)))
        }
    }
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions, SqlitePool, Row};
use std::path::Path;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentMemory {
    pub id: i64,
    pub origin: String,
    pub directive: String,
    pub result: String,
    pub timestamp: String,
}

pub struct MemoryPalace {
    pub pool: SqlitePool,
}

impl MemoryPalace {
    pub async fn new(db_path: &str) -> Result<Self, sqlx::Error> {
        if !Path::new(db_path).exists() {
            std::fs::File::create(db_path).ok();
        }
        let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(5)
            .connect(&format!("sqlite:{}", db_path))
            .await?;
        let palace = Self { pool };
        palace.init_full_schema().await?;
        Ok(palace)
    }

    pub async fn init_full_schema(&self) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS neural_context (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            origin TEXT NOT NULL,
            directive TEXT NOT NULL,
            result TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;

        sqlx::query("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memory_search USING fts5(
            directive, result, content='neural_context', content_rowid='id'
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;

        sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS healing_metrics (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            layer TEXT NOT NULL,
            success INTEGER NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            cvss REAL,
            notes TEXT
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn store_memory(&self, origin: &str, directive: &str, result: &str) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        let res = sqlx::query("INSERT INTO neural_context (origin, directive, result) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(origin).bind(directive).bind(result).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        let row_id = res.last_insert_rowid();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO memory_search (rowid, directive, result) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(row_id).bind(directive).bind(result).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn fetch_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50")
            .fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|row| AgentMemory {
            id: row.get("id"), origin: row.get("origin"), directive: row.get("directive"),
            result: row.get("result"), timestamp: row.get("timestamp"),
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn purge_all(&self) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM neural_context").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM memory_search").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn search_memories(&self, query: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context 
                                JOIN memory_search ON neural_context.id = memory_search.rowid 
                                WHERE memory_search MATCH ? ORDER BY rank LIMIT 5")
            .bind(query).fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|r| AgentMemory {
            id: r.get("id"), origin: r.get("origin"), directive: r.get("directive"),
            result: r.get("result"), timestamp: r.get("timestamp")
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn get_success_rate_for_layer(&self, layer: &str) -> f32 {
        let result = sqlx::query("SELECT CAST(SUM(success) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate FROM healing_metrics WHERE layer = ?")
            .bind(layer).fetch_optional(&self.pool).await;
        match result {
            Ok(Some(row)) => row.get::<Option<f32>, _>("rate").unwrap_or(0.78),
            _ => 0.78,
        }
    }
}

use prometheus::{Encoder, TextEncoder};

/// Ignite the baseline metrics registry
pub fn init_metrics() {
    // Placeholder for registering custom Prometheus counters/gauges later.
    // Currently a safe no-op to unblock the server route baseline.
}

/// Gathers all registered metrics and formats them for the /api/metrics route
pub fn get_metrics_text() -> String {
    let encoder = TextEncoder::new();
    let mut buffer = vec![];
    
    // Gather from the default global registry
    let metric_families = prometheus::gather();
    
    if let Err(e) = encoder.encode(&metric_families, &mut buffer) {
        eprintln!(">> [METRICS] Encoding failure: {}", e);
    }
    
    String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer).to_string()
}

pub async fn run_repair_sequence(agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, api_key: &str, target: &str) {
    let client = Client::new();
    println!("\x1b[35m>> [MISSION CONTROL] Diagnosis: {}\x1b[0m", target);

    for _attempt in 1..=3 {
        let error_log = if target == "ui" {
            Inquisitor::audit_ui().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.to_string())
        } else {
            Inquisitor::audit_backend().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.to_string())
        };

        if error_log == "NOMINAL" {
            println!("\x1b[32m>> [STABLE] {} nominal\x1b[0m", target);
            return;
        }

        let prompt = format!("CRITICAL ERROR:\n{}\n\nRETURN JSON ONLY: {{\"file\": \"path\", \"fix\": \"code\"}}", error_log);
        
        if let Ok((response, _)) = agent.prepare_and_run(&client, api_key, &prompt, Default::default(), 0.2).await {
            let start = response.find('{');
            let end = response.rfind('}');
            
            if let (Some(s), Some(e)) = (start, end) {
                let clean_json = &response[s..=e];
                if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(clean_json) {
                    let file_path = json["file"].as_str().unwrap_or_default();
                    let fix_code = json["fix"].as_str().unwrap_or_default();

                    if !file_path.is_empty() && !fix_code.is_empty() {
                        let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(agent.clone(), None);
                        if let Ok(report) = arbiter.analyze_directive(api_key, &format!("Audit patch for {}: {}", file_path, fix_code)).await {
                            if report.can_proceed && report.risk_score < 0.45 {
                                let _ = std::fs::write(file_path, fix_code);
                                println!("\x1b[32m>> [SURGERY] Patch applied to {}\x1b[0m", file_path);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::server::AppState;
use crate::component_runner::{AgentHandle, Capabilities};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum StepStatus {
    Pending, Running, Done, Failed(String),
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MissionStep {
    pub id: usize,
    pub description: String,
    pub action: Option<AgentAction>,
    pub status: StepStatus,
    pub result: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Mission {
    pub id: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub steps: Vec<MissionStep>,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub completed: bool,
}

pub struct MissionPlanner;

impl MissionPlanner {
    pub async fn execute(state: &Arc<AppState>, mut mission: Mission) -> anyhow::Result<Mission> {
        let (lifecycle_tx, _) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel(16);

        // Spawn supervised actor handle for the entire mission
        let handle: AgentHandle = crate::component_runner::AgentComponent::spawn(
            &format!("mission-{}", mission.id),
            Capabilities::READ_FS | Capabilities::WRITE_FS,
            state.agent.clone(),
            lifecycle_tx,
        );

        for step in mission.steps.iter_mut() {
            if step.status != StepStatus::Pending { continue; }
            step.status = StepStatus::Running;

            if let Some(action) = step.action.clone() {
                match handle.execute_actions(vec![action]).await {
                    Ok(results) => {
                        step.status = StepStatus::Done;
                        step.result = Some(results.join("\n"));
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        step.status = StepStatus::Failed(e.to_string());
                        // Log to lifecycle for supervision
                        let _ = state.tx.send(format!("Mission step {} failed: {}", step.id, e));
                        break; // Stop on first failure (fail-fast)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mission.completed = mission.steps.iter().all(|s| matches!(s.status, StepStatus::Done));
        Ok(mission)
    }
}

use anyhow::Result;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions, SqlitePool, Row};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PersistentMission {
    pub id: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub status: String,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub payload: String,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct MissionQueue {
    pool: SqlitePool,
}

impl MissionQueue {
    pub async fn new(db_path: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(5)
            .connect(&format!("sqlite:{}", db_path))
            .await?;

        let queue = Self { pool };
        queue.init_schema().await?;
        Ok(queue)
    }

    async fn init_schema(&self) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS missions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                goal TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                payload TEXT NOT NULL
            )"
        )
        .execute(&self.pool)
        .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn enqueue(&self, mission: PersistentMission) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO missions (id, goal, status, created_at, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(&mission.id)
            .bind(&mission.goal)
            .bind(&mission.status)
            .bind(mission.created_at)
            .bind(&mission.payload)
            .execute(&self.pool)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_pending(&self) -> Result<Vec<PersistentMission>> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, goal, status, created_at, payload FROM missions WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at")
            .fetch_all(&self.pool)
            .await?;

        let mut results = Vec::new();
        for row in rows {
            results.push(PersistentMission {
                id: row.get("id"),
                goal: row.get("goal"),
                status: row.get("status"),
                created_at: row.get("created_at"),
                payload: row.get("payload"),
            });
        }
        Ok(results)
    }

    pub async fn update_status(&self, id: &str, status: &str) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query("UPDATE missions SET status = ? WHERE id = ?")
            .bind(status)
            .bind(id)
            .execute(&self.pool)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

use std::fs::File;
use std::io::Read;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct NanoAgent {
    pub load: Arc<AtomicU32>,
}

impl NanoAgent {
    pub fn inject() -> Self {
        let load = Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0));
        let l_clone = load.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (mut p_idle, mut p_total) = (0, 0);
            let mut buf = [0u8; 512];
            loop {
                if let Ok(mut f) = File::open("/proc/stat") {
                    let n = f.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0);
                    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]);
                    if let Some(line) = s.lines().next() {
                        let v: Vec<u64> = line.split_whitespace().filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
                        if v.len() >= 4 {
                            let total: u64 = v.iter().sum();
                            let idle = v[3];
                            let (td, id) = (total - p_total, idle - p_idle);
                            if td > 0 {
                                let usage = ((td - id) as f32 / td as f32) * 100.0;
                                l_clone.store(usage.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
                            }
                            p_total = total; p_idle = idle;
                        }
                    }
                }
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(1000));
            }
        });
        Self { load }
    }

    pub async fn run_cycle(&self) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let usage = f32::from_bits(self.load.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        Ok(format!("Telemetry Pulse: CPU at {:.2}%", usage))
    }
}

impl Default for NanoAgent {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::inject()
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use crate::resonator::resonator_ignite;
use crate::kernel::realignment::ALIGN_MASK;

pub struct NativeAgent {
    pub id: String,
    pub mission_profile: String,
    pub is_active: bool,
    pub hardware_affinity: String,
}

pub struct NativeAgentManager {
    pub agents: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, NativeAgent>>>,
}

impl NativeAgentManager {
    pub fn init() -> Self {
        let mut agents = HashMap::new();
        // Initialize the 68 core agents
        for i in 0..68 {
            let id = format!("agent_{}", i);
            agents.insert(id.clone(), NativeAgent {
                id: id.clone(),
                mission_profile: format!("nexus_task_profile_{}", id),
                is_active: false,
                hardware_affinity: "CPU".to_string(),
            });
        }
        Self { agents: Arc::new(Mutex::new(agents)) }
    }

    /// 0.90 Handshake: Verifies hardware signature of the ARM64 NPU
    async fn verify_npu_signature(&self) -> Result<bool> {
        // Simulated hardware register check
        Ok(true) 
    }

    pub async fn ignite_agent(&self, agent_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let mut agents = self.agents.lock().await;
        let agent = agents.get_mut(agent_id).ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Agent not found"))?;

        // Phase 1: NPU Negotiation
        if self.verify_npu_signature().await.unwrap_or(false) {
            let ptr = agent.mission_profile.as_ptr() as usize;
            
            // Phase 2: Enforce 64-byte ALIGN_MASK (Zero-copy safety)
            if (ptr & ALIGN_MASK) == 0 {
                agent.hardware_affinity = "NPU".to_string();
                eprintln!(">> [NPU_UPLINK] Agent {} bound to NPU (Aligned)", agent_id);
            } else {
                agent.hardware_affinity = "CPU_ATOMIC".to_string();
                eprintln!(">> [ALIGN_FAULT] Realignment required. Falling back to CPU.");
            }
        }

        // Phase 3: FFI Ignition via Zig Resonator
        let profile = &agent.mission_profile;
        if unsafe { resonator_ignite(profile.as_ptr(), profile.len()) } {
            agent.is_active = true;
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(anyhow!("Ignition sequence failed"))
        }
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

/// start_duet_listener: Polls for remote git commands on a 60-second cycle.
///
/// FIX: The previous implementation used std::thread::sleep inside a blocking
/// loop. If this function was ever spawned on a Tokio worker thread (via
/// tokio::spawn), it would park the thread for 60 seconds per iteration,
/// starving other tasks on the same thread. This is now an async fn using
/// tokio::time::sleep, which yields the thread back to the runtime while waiting.
///
/// Callers should use: tokio::spawn(network::start_duet_listener());
pub async fn start_duet_listener() {
    println!(">> [SOVEREIGN] DUET LISTENER ACTIVE.");
    loop {
        // Non-blocking git fetch check for external command dispatch
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(["fetch", "origin"]).output();
        // Yields the Tokio thread back to the runtime during the wait
        sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
    }
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/src/src/neural_agent.rs]

use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use reqwest::Client;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use futures_util::StreamExt;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Default)]
pub struct ContextPacket {
    pub current_file: String,
    pub recent_logs: Vec<String>,
    pub file_content: Option<String>,
    pub terminal_log: Option<String>,
    pub system_prompt: Option<String>,
    pub target_model: Option<String>,
}

pub struct MicroAgent {
    pub memory: Mutex<VecDeque<Value>>,
    pub tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
}

impl MicroAgent {
    pub fn init(tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Result<Self, NexusError> {
        Ok(MicroAgent { memory: Mutex::new(VecDeque::with_capacity(16)), tx })
    }

    pub async fn prepare_and_run(
        &self,
        client: &Client,
        api_key: &str,
        user_text: &str,
        ctx: ContextPacket,
        _resonance: f32,
    ) -> Result<(String, u128), NexusError> {
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();
        
        // UPGRADE: Targeting the MoE variant for high-speed, 500-error-free execution
        let model = ctx.target_model.unwrap_or_else(|| "gemma-4-31b-it".to_string());
        
        // GEMMA 4 PROTOCOL: <|think|> trigger in the native system prompt
        let system_instruction = format!(
            "<|think|>SYSTEM_PROMPT: {}\nACTIVE_FILE: {}\nFILE_CONTENT:\n```\n{}\n```",
            ctx.system_prompt.unwrap_or_else(|| "You are NEXUS Ghost, a Sovereign AI Architect.".to_string()),
            ctx.current_file,
            ctx.file_content.unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string())
        );

        let url = format!(
            "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&key={}", 
            model, 
            api_key
        );

        // GEMMA 4 PROTOCOL: Strict Role Separation and Sampling lock
        let payload = json!({ 
            "contents": [
                {
                    "role": "system",
                    "parts": [{ "text": system_instruction }]
                },
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "parts": [{ "text": format!("DIRECTIVE: {}", user_text) }]
                }
            ],
            "generationConfig": {
                "temperature": 1.0,
                "maxOutputTokens": 8192,
                "topP": 0.95,
                "topK": 64
            }
        });
        
        let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_start"}).to_string());

        let response = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("UPLINK_FAIL: {}", e)))?;

        if !response.status().is_success() {
            let status = response.status();
            let err_text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_end"}).to_string());
            let formatted_err = format!("API_HTTP_{}: {}", status, err_text);
            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "error", "payload": &formatted_err}).to_string());
            return Err(NexusError::Other(formatted_err));
        }

        let mut full_text = String::new();
        let mut line_buffer = String::new();
        let mut stream = response.bytes_stream();

        while let Some(item) = stream.next().await {
            if let Ok(bytes) = item {
                // CRLF normalization ensures the parser doesn't fracture
                line_buffer.push_str(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes).replace("\r\n", "\n"));

                while let Some(newline_pos) = line_buffer.find("\n\n") {
                    let chunk = line_buffer[..newline_pos].trim().to_string();
                    line_buffer.drain(..newline_pos + 2);

                    let clean = chunk.trim_start_matches("data: ").trim();
                    if clean.is_empty() || clean == "[DONE]" || clean == "[" || clean == "]" { continue; }
                    
                    if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(clean) {
                        if let Some(err) = val.get("error") {
                            let msg = err["message"].as_str().unwrap_or("API error");
                            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "error", "payload": msg}).to_string());
                            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_end"}).to_string());
                            return Err(NexusError::Other(format!("API_STREAM_ERROR: {}", msg)));
                        }
                        if let Some(token) = val["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
                            full_text.push_str(token);
                            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_token", "payload": token}).to_string());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let leftover = line_buffer.trim_start_matches("data: ").trim();
        if !leftover.is_empty() && leftover != "[DONE]" && leftover != "[" && leftover != "]" {
            if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(leftover) {
                if let Some(token) = val["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
                    full_text.push_str(token);
                    let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_token", "payload": token}).to_string());
                }
            }
        }

        if full_text.is_empty() {
            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "error", "payload": "GHOST_CORTEX: Empty response."}).to_string());
        }

        let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_end"}).to_string());
        Ok((full_text, start.elapsed().as_millis()))
    }
}

use std::fmt;
use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum NexusError {
    NotFound(String),
    Patch(String),
    KernelFault(KernelError),
    NeuralLinkSevered(String),
    Other(String),
    SecurityViolation { message: String, cvss: f32 },
}

impl fmt::Display for NexusError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::SecurityViolation { message, cvss } => write!(f, "!! [SECURITY] CVSS {:.1}: {}", cvss, message),
            Self::KernelFault(e) => write!(f, "!! [KERNEL_DNA_FAULT] {}", e),
            Self::NotFound(e) => write!(f, ">> [FS_FAULT] Not Found: {}", e),
            Self::Patch(e) => write!(f, ">> [DIFF_FAULT] Patch Failed: {}", e),
            Self::NeuralLinkSevered(e) => write!(f, "!! [UPLINK_FAULT]: {}", e),
            Self::Other(e) => write!(f, ">> [SYSTEM_FAULT]: {}", e),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for NexusError {}

impl From<std::io::Error> for NexusError {
    fn from(err: std::io::Error) -> Self {
        NexusError::Other(format!("IO_FAULT: {}", err))
    }
}

impl From<KernelError> for NexusError {
    fn from(err: KernelError) -> Self {
        NexusError::KernelFault(err)
    }
}
