use crate::neural_agent::{MicroAgent, ContextPacket};
use crate::component_runner::AgentHandle;
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent;
use anyhow::Result;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct Orchestrator {
    pub agent: Arc<MicroAgent>,
    handle: AgentHandle,
}

impl Orchestrator {
    pub fn new(agent: Arc<MicroAgent>) -> Self {
        let (tx, _) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel(16);
        let handle = crate::component_runner::AgentComponent::spawn(
            "orchestrator",
            crate::component_runner::Capabilities::READ_FS | crate::component_runner::Capabilities::WRITE_FS,
            agent.clone(),
            tx,
        );

        Self { agent, handle }
    }

    pub async fn run_autonomous_loop(
        &self,
        instruction: String,
        context: ContextPacket,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        api_key: &str,
        _tx: &tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>,
        _monitor: &crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor,
    ) -> Result<String> {
        let (raw_response, _) = self.agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &instruction, context, 1.0)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e.to_string()))?;

        match AgentAction::extract_and_parse(&raw_response) {
            Ok(actions) => {
                // UPGRADE: Consult the Arbiter before executing the loop
                let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(self.agent.clone(), None);
                let action_json = serde_json::to_string(&actions).unwrap_or_default();
                
                if let Ok(report) = arbiter.analyze_directive(api_key, &action_json).await {
                    if !report.can_proceed || report.risk_score >= 0.45 {
                        return Ok(format!("!! [ARBITER BLOCK] Risk Score: {:.2}. Reason: {}", report.risk_score, report.recommendation));
                    }
                }

                let results: Vec<String> = self.handle.execute_actions(actions).await
                    .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e.to_string()))?;
                Ok(results.join("\n"))
            }
            Err(e) => {
                println!(">> [ORCHESTRATOR] Protocol extraction failed: {}. Returning raw response.", e);
                Ok(raw_response)
            }
        }
    }
}

use tokio::process::Command;
use std::process::Stdio;
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, BufReader};
use anyhow::Result;

pub struct PodmanShield;

impl PodmanShield {
    /// execute_isolated: Asynchronous Zircon-style IPC stream
    pub async fn execute_isolated(directive: &str, workspace_path: &str) -> Result<String> {
        println!(">> [SHIELD] Opening Async IPC Channel to Bio-Dome...");

        let mut child = Command::new("podman")
            .args([
                "run",
                "--rm",
                "--network", "none",            // Air-gapped
                "--memory", "512m",             // Resource governed
                "-v", &format!("{}:/workspace:z", workspace_path), // 'z' for Crostini/Termux safety
                "-w", "/workspace",
                "docker.io/library/rust:alpine",
                "sh", "-c", directive
            ])
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()?;

        let stdout = child.stdout.take().expect("Failed to capture Bio-Dome stdout");
        let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdout).lines();
        let mut output_buffer = String::new();

        // Real-time telemetry feed
        while let Ok(Some(line)) = reader.next_line().await {
            // Echoing the stream live to the host terminal
            println!(">> [BIO-DOME TELEMETRY]: {}", line);
            
            // Zircon-style Signal Check: The Arbiter's kill switch
            if line.contains("MALICIOUS_INTENT") {
                println!("!! [ARBITER] Rogue behavior detected. Severing IPC.");
                let _ = child.kill().await;
                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("SHIELD_BREACH: Malicious intent intercepted."));
            }
            
            output_buffer.push_str(&line);
            output_buffer.push('\n');
        }

        let status = child.wait().await?;
        if status.success() {
            println!(">> [SHIELD] Bio-Dome process completed successfully.");
            Ok(output_buffer)
        } else {
            Err(anyhow::anyhow!("SHIELD_FAULT: Bio-Dome exited with {}", status))
        }
    }
}

use std::path::Path;
use std::process::Command;
use serde::Serialize;
use walkdir::WalkDir;

#[derive(Serialize)]
pub struct BuildResult {
    pub success: bool,
    pub log: String,
    pub detected_stack: String,
}

pub fn detect_and_build(path: &str) -> BuildResult {
    let p = Path::new(path);

    let (cmd, args, stack) = if p.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
        ("cargo", vec!["build", "--release"], "RUST")
    } else if p.join("package.json").exists() {
        ("npm", vec!["run", "build"], "NODEJS")
    } else if p.join("requirements.txt").exists() {
        ("pip", vec!["install", "-r", "requirements.txt"], "PYTHON")
    } else if p.join("Makefile").exists() {
        ("make", vec![], "MAKEFILE")
    } else {
        return BuildResult {
            success: false,
            log: ">> UNKNOWN STACK".to_string(),
            detected_stack: "UNKNOWN".into(),
        };
    };

    println!(">> [POLYGLOT] Building {} project at {}...", stack, path);
    let output = Command::new(cmd).args(&args).current_dir(path).output();

    match output {
        Ok(out) => {
            let log = format!(
                "STDOUT:\n{}\nSTDERR:\n{}",
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout),
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)
            );
            BuildResult {
                success: out.status.success(),
                log,
                detected_stack: stack.into(),
            }
        }
        Err(e) => BuildResult {
            success: false,
            log: e.to_string(),
            detected_stack: stack.into(),
        },
    }
}

pub fn generate_project_tree() -> String {
    let mut tree = String::from("PROJECT STRUCTURE:\n");
    for entry in WalkDir::new(".")
        .max_depth(2)
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
    {
        let path = entry.path();
        let display = path.display().to_string();

        if display.contains("/target")
            || display.contains("/.git")
            || display.contains("/node_modules")
            || display.contains("/dist")
        {
            continue;
        }

        let depth = display.matches('/').count();
        let indent = "  ".repeat(depth);
        tree.push_str(&format!(
            "{}{}\n",
            indent,
            path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy()
        ));
    }
    tree
}

const std = @import("std");

/// Pulls live thermal data from the kernel (ARM64 safe)
export fn get_thermal_temp() callconv(.C) f32 {
    const path = "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp";
    var file = std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{}) catch return 0.0;
    defer file.close();

    var buf: [16]u8 = undefined;
    const amt = file.readAll(&buf) catch return 0.0;
    if (amt == 0) return 0.0;
    
    const temp_str = std.mem.trim(u8, buf[0..amt], " \n\t\r");
    const temp_raw = std.fmt.parseFloat(f32, temp_str) catch return 0.0;
    
    return temp_raw / 1000.0;
}

/// Hardware bind success stub (always returns true for current ARM64 stability)
export fn resonator_ignite(path_ptr: [*]const u8, path_len: usize) callconv(.C) bool {
    _ = path_ptr;
    _ = path_len;
    return true; 
}

export fn scan_entropy() callconv(.C) f32 {
    return 0.95; // High entropy baseline for NEXUS resonance
}

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use std::env;

/// Validates that a requested path strictly resides within the Nexus workspace.
/// Neutralizes directory traversal attacks (e.g., "../../../etc/shadow").
pub fn validate_path(requested_path: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let workspace_root = env::current_dir()?;
    let target_path = Path::new(requested_path);
    
    // Resolve to an absolute path first
    let absolute_target = if target_path.is_absolute() {
        target_path.to_path_buf()
    } else {
        workspace_root.join(target_path)
    };

    // To prevent symlink escapes and normalize ".." traversals, we must canonicalize.
    // Canonicalization requires the path to exist. If creating a new file, we check the parent.
    let mut check_path = absolute_target.clone();
    if !check_path.exists() {
        if let Some(parent) = check_path.parent() {
            check_path = parent.to_path_buf();
        } else {
            return Err(anyhow!("Invalid path structure requested."));
        }
    }

    // Resolve the actual physical paths on the ARM64 disk
    let canonical_target = check_path.canonicalize()
        .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Sandbox resolution failed: {}", e))?;
    let canonical_root = workspace_root.canonicalize()
        .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Workspace root resolution failed: {}", e))?;

    // The core security check: Does the target physically reside inside the root?
    if canonical_target.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
        Ok(absolute_target)
    } else {
        Err(anyhow!(
            "[SECURITY VIOLATION] Agent attempted directory traversal outside workspace bounds: {}", 
            requested_path
        ))
    }
}

use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot, broadcast, Mutex};
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};
use crate::neural_agent::ContextPacket;
use crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator;
use crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor;
use crate::mission_queue::MissionQueue;
use crate::thermal_governor::ThermalGovernor;
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Domain { UI, Code, Build, Security }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub enum TaskPriority { Low, Normal, High, Critical }

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NexusTask {
    pub priority: TaskPriority, // SUTURE: Moved to first position for correct sorting
    pub id: String,
    pub domain: Domain,
    pub payload: String,
    pub context: ContextPacket,
    pub response_tx: Option<oneshot::Sender<String>>,
}

// Manual Ord implementation to ensure Priority takes precedence over ID
impl Ord for NexusTask {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
        self.priority.cmp(&other.priority).then_with(|| self.id.cmp(&other.id))
    }
}

impl PartialOrd for NexusTask {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> { Some(self.cmp(other)) }
}

impl PartialEq for NexusTask {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self.priority == other.priority && self.id == other.id }
}

impl Eq for NexusTask {}

pub struct MasterSupervisor;

impl MasterSupervisor {
    pub fn ignite(
        b_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
        client: reqwest::Client,
        api_key: String,
        orchestrator: Arc<Orchestrator>,
        _resonance: Arc<AtomicU32>,
        _monitor: SystemMonitor,
        memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>,
    ) -> mpsc::Sender<NexusTask> {
        let (global_tx, mut global_rx) = mpsc::channel::<NexusTask>(128);

        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let queue = match MissionQueue::new(".nexus_missions.db").await {
                Ok(q) => q,
                Err(e) => {
                    let _ = b_tx.send(format!("!! [QUEUE FAULT] {}", e));
                    return;
                }
            };

            let governor = ThermalGovernor::new();
            let mut heap: std::collections::BinaryHeap<NexusTask> = std::collections::BinaryHeap::new();

            loop {
                while let Ok(task) = global_rx.try_recv() {
                    heap.push(task);
                }

                governor.apply_cooldown().await;

                if let Some(task) = heap.pop() {
                    let orch = orchestrator.clone();
                    let cl = client.clone();
                    let ak = api_key.clone();
                    let q = queue.clone();
                    let mem = memory.clone();
                    let task_id = task.id.clone();
                    let b_tx_clone = b_tx.clone();

                    tokio::spawn(async move {
                        let _ = q.update_status(&task_id, "running").await;
                        let _ = b_tx_clone.send(format!("\x1b[35m>> [DRONE ACTIVE] Executing Task: {}\x1b[0m", task_id));

                        let result = crate::task_manager::send_task(
                            orch.agent.clone(), &cl, &ak, &task.payload, mem
                        ).await;
                        
                        let _ = q.update_status(&task_id, "done").await;
                        let _ = b_tx_clone.send(format!("\x1b[35m>> [DRONE COMPLETE] Task: {}\x1b[0m", task_id));

                        if let Some(tx) = task.response_tx { let _ = tx.send(result); }
                    });
                }
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
            }
        });

        global_tx
    }
}

use crate::{
    inquisitor::Inquisitor,
    arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent,
    thermal_governor::ThermalGovernor,
    mission_planner::{Mission, MissionStep, StepStatus},
    memory::MemoryPalace,
    server::AppState,
};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};
use chrono::Utc;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum HealingLayer {
    Kernel, Backend, Frontend, Swarm,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct HealingIssue {
    pub layer: HealingLayer,
    pub description: String,
    pub cvss: f32,
}

pub struct SelfHealingEngine {
    state: Arc<AppState>,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>,
    governor: ThermalGovernor,
}

impl SelfHealingEngine {
    pub fn new(state: Arc<AppState>, memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>) -> Self {
        Self {
            state,
            memory,
            governor: ThermalGovernor::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn ignite_autonomic_loop(self) {
        println!("\x1b[36m>> [SELF-HEALING v2.0] Autonomic Loop Started (4GB safe)\x1b[0m");

        loop {
            self.governor.apply_cooldown().await;

            let vitals = self.state.monitor.get_vitals();

            // Strong resource guard for Lenovo Duet 4GB
            if vitals.cpu_load > 0.65 || vitals.temperature > 68.0 || vitals.ram_gb > 3.2 {
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(90)).await;
                continue;
            }

            let issues = self.diagnose().await;
            for issue in issues {
                let priority = self.calculate_priority(&issue, &vitals).await;
                if priority > 0.52 {
                    let mission = self.create_mission(&issue).await;
                    let _ = crate::mission_planner::MissionPlanner::execute(&self.state, mission).await;
                }
            }

            self.record_cycle().await;
            sleep(Duration::from_secs(75)).await;
        }
    }

    async fn diagnose(&self) -> Vec<HealingIssue> {
        let mut issues = Vec::new();

        if let Ok(log) = Inquisitor::audit_backend() {
            if log != "NOMINAL" {
                issues.push(HealingIssue { layer: HealingLayer::Backend, description: log, cvss: 7.5 });
            }
        }
        if let Ok(log) = Inquisitor::audit_ui() {
            if log != "NOMINAL" {
                issues.push(HealingIssue { layer: HealingLayer::Frontend, description: log, cvss: 6.8 });
            }
        }
        issues
    }

    async fn calculate_priority(&self, issue: &HealingIssue, vitals: &crate::system_monitor::Vitals) -> f32 {
        let base = issue.cvss / 10.0;
        let thermal_factor = if vitals.temperature > 65.0 { 0.6 } else { 1.0 };
        base * thermal_factor * 0.78   // simple historical factor
    }

    async fn create_mission(&self, issue: &HealingIssue) -> Mission {
        let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(self.state.agent.clone(), Some(self.state.orchestrator.clone()));
        let _ = arbiter.analyze_directive(&self.state.api_key, &issue.description).await;

        Mission {
            id: format!("heal-{}", Utc::now().timestamp()),
            goal: format!("Repair {:?}", issue.layer),
            steps: vec![
                MissionStep { id: 1, description: "Lazarus pre-snapshot".into(), action: None, status: StepStatus::Pending, result: None },
                MissionStep { id: 2, description: format!("Fix {:?}", issue.layer), action: None, status: StepStatus::Pending, result: None },
                MissionStep { id: 3, description: "Validate repair".into(), action: None, status: StepStatus::Pending, result: None },
            ],
            created_at: Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            completed: false,
        }
    }

    async fn record_cycle(&self) {
        let palace = self.memory.lock().await;
        let _ = palace.store_memory(
            "SelfHealingEngine",
            "autonomic_cycle",
            "Completed diagnostic + repair pass with learning feedback",
        ).await;
    }
}

use std::fs;

pub fn is_fit_for_work() -> bool {
    // Check Load Average to prevent overheating on the Duet
    if let Ok(load_str) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/loadavg") {
        let load: f32 = load_str.split_whitespace()
            .next()
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        // Throttle if load > 4.0 (Quad Core saturation)
        if load > 4.0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use tokio_util::io::ReaderStream;

pub async fn handle_factory_export() -> impl IntoResponse {
    let folder = ".lazarus/factory";
    let output_zip = "nexus_factory_export.zip";

    let _ = std::process::Command::new("zip")
        .args(["-r", "-j", output_zip, folder])
        .status();

    let file = match tokio::fs::File::open(output_zip).await {
        Ok(f) => f,
        Err(_) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Export Failed").into_response(),
    };

    let stream = ReaderStream::new(file);
    let body = axum::body::Body::from_stream(stream);

    Response::builder()
        .header("Content-Type", "application/zip")
        .header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=\"nexus_swarm_factory.zip\"")
        .body(body)
        .unwrap()
}

use axum::{
    extract::{Query, State, ws::{WebSocketUpgrade, WebSocket, Message}},
    http::{header, StatusCode, Uri},
    response::IntoResponse,
    routing::{get, post, delete},
    Json, Router,
};
use rust_embed::RustEmbed;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::json;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tower_http::cors::CorsLayer;
use crate::{task_manager, sandbox};

#[derive(RustEmbed)]
#[folder = "ui/dist/"]
struct Assets;

pub struct AppState {
    pub client: reqwest::Client,
    pub monitor: crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor,
    pub agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
    pub orchestrator: Arc<crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator>,
    pub memory: Arc<tokio::sync::Mutex<crate::memory::MemoryPalace>>,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub current_resonance: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32>,
    pub tx: tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>,
    pub scheduler_tx: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<crate::scheduler::NexusTask>,
    pub arbiter: Arc<crate::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent>,
    pub local_llm: Arc<crate::local_llm::LocalLLM>,
    pub workspace_root: std::path::PathBuf,
}

pub async fn start_server(state: Arc<AppState>) {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/api/fs/list", get(handle_fs_list))
        .route("/api/fs/read", get(handle_read_file))
        .route("/api/fs/write", post(handle_write_file))
        .route("/api/fs/delete", delete(handle_delete_file))
        .route("/api/memories", get(handle_get_memories))
        .route("/api/memories/search", get(handle_search_memories))
        .route("/api/memories/purge", delete(handle_purge_memories))
        .route("/api/missions", get(handle_get_missions))
        .route("/api/lazarus/snapshots", get(handle_lazarus_snapshots))
        .route("/api/task", post(handle_task))
        .route("/ws/nexus", get(ws_handler))
        .fallback(static_handler)
        .with_state(state)
        .layer(CorsLayer::permissive());

    let addr = "0.0.0.0:3000";
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(&addr).await.unwrap();
    println!("\x1b[38;2;0;255;255m>> [NEXUS SERVER] UNIFIED UPLINK: http://localhost:3000\x1b[0m");
    axum::serve(listener, app.into_make_service()).await.unwrap();
}

async fn handle_fs_list(Query(p): Query<ListParams>, State(_state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let path = p.path.as_deref().unwrap_or(".");
    match sandbox::validate_path(path) {
        Ok(safe) => {
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(&safe) {
                for entry in rd.flatten() {
                    let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                    if !name.starts_with('.') && name != "target" && name != "node_modules" {
                        entries.push(FsEntry {
                            name,
                            path: entry.path().to_string_lossy().to_string(),
                            is_dir: entry.path().is_dir(),
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            (StatusCode::OK, Json(entries)).into_response()
        }
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_get_memories(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await;
    match palace.fetch_all().await {
        Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Memory Read Fault: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_search_memories(Query(q): Query<SearchQuery>, State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let query = q.q.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await;
    match palace.search_memories(query).await {
        Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Search Fault: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_purge_memories(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await;
    match palace.purge_all().await {
        Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK.into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Purge Fault: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_get_missions() -> impl IntoResponse {
    match crate::mission_queue::MissionQueue::new(".nexus_missions.db").await {
        Ok(queue) => match queue.get_pending().await {
            Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(),
            Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Queue Error: {}", e)).into_response(),
        },
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Init Error: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_lazarus_snapshots() -> impl IntoResponse {
    match crate::lazarus_vault::LazarusVault::list_snapshots() {
        Ok(snaps) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(snaps)).into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Vault Error: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_task(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>, Json(payload): Json<TaskRequest>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let agent = state.agent.clone();
    let client = state.client.clone();
    let api_key = state.api_key.clone();
    let memory = state.memory.clone();
    let directive = payload.directive.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let _ = task_manager::send_task(agent, &client, &api_key, &directive, memory).await;
    });
    Json(json!({ "status": "QUEUED" }))
}

async fn ws_handler(ws: WebSocketUpgrade, State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    ws.on_upgrade(|socket| handle_socket(socket, state))
}

async fn handle_socket(mut socket: WebSocket, state: Arc<AppState>) {
    let mut rx = state.tx.subscribe();
    let mut heartbeat = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            Ok(msg) = rx.recv() => {
                if socket.send(Message::Text(msg)).await.is_err() { break; }
            }
            _ = heartbeat.tick() => {
                let v = state.monitor.get_vitals();
                let payload = json!({ "type": "telemetry", "payload": v });
                if socket.send(Message::Text(payload.to_string())).await.is_err() { break; }
            }
            Some(Ok(msg)) = socket.recv() => {
                if let Message::Text(text) = msg {
                    if let Ok(parsed) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&text) {
                        if parsed["type"] == "directive" {
                            let mut cmd = parsed["payload"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
                            
                            // === SUTURE: AUTONOMIC CONTEXT INJECTOR ===
                            let lower_cmd = cmd.to_lowercase();
                            if lower_cmd.contains("audit") || lower_cmd.contains("all the code") {
                                let _ = state.tx.send(String::from(">> [CORTEX_UPLINK] Broad audit detected. Injecting local workspace DNA..."));
                                let mut context = String::from("\n\n--- [SYSTEM WORKSPACE DNA] ---\n");
                                
                                if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir("src") {
                                    for entry in entries.flatten() {
                                        let path = entry.path();
                                        if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                                            if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                                                // Hard limit to prevent token explosion
                                                let preview = &content; // GEMMA-4 262K UNLOCKED
                                                context.push_str(&format!("\n// === FILE: {} ===\n{}\n", path.display(), preview));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                cmd.push_str(&context);
                            }
                            
                            let state_clone = state.clone();
                            tokio::spawn(async move {
                                let _ = task_manager::send_task(
                                    state_clone.agent.clone(),
                                    &state_clone.client,
                                    &state_clone.api_key,
                                    &cmd,
                                    state_clone.memory.clone()
                                ).await;
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else => break,
        }
    }
}

async fn static_handler(uri: Uri) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let path = uri.path().trim_start_matches('/').to_string();
    let final_path = if path.is_empty() { "index.html".to_string() } else { path };
    match Assets::get(&final_path) {
        Some(content) => ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime_guess::from_path(&final_path).first_or_octet_stream().as_ref())], content.data).into_response(),
        None => if !final_path.contains('.') { ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html")], Assets::get("index.html").unwrap().data).into_response() } 
                else { StatusCode::NOT_FOUND.into_response() }
    }
}

async fn handle_read_file(Query(p): Query<FileParams>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    match sandbox::validate_path(&p.path) {
        Ok(safe) => match std::fs::read_to_string(&safe) {
            Ok(c) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(json!({ "content": c }))).into_response(),
            Err(_) => (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "File not found").into_response(),
        },
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_write_file(Json(payload): Json<FileContent>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    match sandbox::validate_path(&payload.path) {
        Ok(safe) => {
            if let Some(p) = safe.parent() { let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(p); }
            match std::fs::write(&safe, &payload.content) {
                Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK.into_response(),
                Err(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.into_response(),
            }
        }
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_delete_file(Query(p): Query<FileParams>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    match sandbox::validate_path(&p.path) {
        Ok(safe) => {
            let res = if safe.is_dir() { std::fs::remove_dir_all(&safe) } else { std::fs::remove_file(&safe) };
            match res {
                Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK.into_response(),
                Err(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.into_response(),
            }
        }
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)] pub struct TaskRequest  { pub directive: String }

#[derive(Deserialize)] pub struct ListParams   { pub path: Option<String> }
#[derive(Deserialize)] pub struct SearchQuery  { pub q: Option<String> }
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize)] pub struct FileContent { pub path: String, pub content: String }
#[derive(Serialize)]   pub struct FsEntry      { pub name: String, pub path: String, pub is_dir: bool }

use axum::{extract::State, response::IntoResponse, Json};
use serde_json::json;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::fs;
use crate::server::AppState;
use crate::lazarus_vault::LazarusVault;
use crate::diff::DiffEngine;

pub async fn terminal_command(
    State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>, 
    Json(payload): Json<serde_json::Value>
) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let cmd_line = payload["command"].as_str().unwrap_or("").trim();
    if cmd_line.is_empty() { return "".into_response(); }

    let parts: Vec<&str> = cmd_line.split_whitespace().collect();
    let command = parts[0].to_lowercase();

    let response = match command.as_str() {
        "open" => {
            let file = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"");
            json!({"type": "action", "action": "OPEN_FILE", "file": file}).to_string()
        },
        "close" => {
            let file = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&"");
            json!({"type": "action", "action": "CLOSE_FILE", "file": file}).to_string()
        },
        "ls" | "dir" => {
            let target = parts.get(1).unwrap_or(&".");
            let mut out = format!(">> DIRECTORY LISTING [{}]:\n", target);
            if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(target) {
                for entry in rd.flatten() {
                    let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                    if !name.starts_with('.') && name != "target" { 
                        let suffix = if entry.path().is_dir() { "/" } else { "" };
                        out.push_str(&format!("    {}{}\n", name, suffix)); 
                    }
                }
            } else {
                out.push_str("    [Directory not found or inaccessible]\n");
            }
            json!({"type": "output", "data": out}).to_string()
        },
        "status" => {
            let v = state.monitor.get_vitals();
            // SUTURE: Aligned field names with standardized Vitals struct (ram_gb)
            json!({
                "type": "output", 
                "data": format!(">> STATUS | TEMP: {:.1}C | CPU: {:.1}% | RAM: {:.2}GB", 
                    v.temperature, 
                    v.cpu_load * 100.0, 
                    v.ram_gb
                )
            }).to_string()
        },
        "diff" => {
            if let Some(hash) = parts.get(1) {
                let snapshots = LazarusVault::list_snapshots().unwrap_or_default();
                if let Some(snap) = snapshots.iter().find(|s| s.hash.starts_with(hash)) {
                    if let Ok(current) = fs::read_to_string(&snap.path) {
                        let snapshot_content = fs::read_to_string(&snap.backup_path).unwrap_or_default();
                        let unified = DiffEngine::unified_diff(&snapshot_content, &current, &snap.path);
                        json!({"type": "diff_view", "diff": unified, "hash": hash}).to_string()
                    } else {
                        json!({"type": "output", "data": format!(">> ERR: File {} missing.", snap.path)}).to_string()
                    }
                } else {
                    json!({"type": "output", "data": format!(">> ERR: Hash {} not found.", hash)}).to_string()
                }
            } else {
                json!({"type": "output", "data": ">> Usage: diff <hash>"}).to_string()
            }
        },
        "lazarus" | "history" => {
            match LazarusVault::list_snapshots() {
                Ok(snaps) => {
                    let mut out = format!(">> ARCHIVES: {} items\n", snaps.len());
                    for s in snaps.iter().rev().take(5) { out.push_str(&format!("    {} | {}\n", &s.hash[..8], s.path)); }
                    json!({"type": "output", "data": out}).to_string()
                },
                _ => json!({"type": "output", "data": ">> Vault Empty"}).to_string()
            }
        },
        "clear" => json!({"type": "action", "action": "CLEAR_TERMINAL"}).to_string(),
        _ => json!({"type": "output", "data": format!(">> Directive '{}' not recognized.", command)}).to_string(),
    };

    format!("{}\n", response).into_response()
}

use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default, Debug)]
pub struct ForgeStats {
    pub file_metrics: HashMap<String, FileMetric>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FileMetric {
    pub successes: u32,
    pub failures: u32,
}

impl ForgeStats {
    pub fn load() -> Self {
        fs::read_to_string(".forge_stats.json")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|content| serde_json::from_str(&content).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        if let Ok(content) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self) {
            let _ = fs::write(".forge_stats.json", content);
        }
    }

    pub fn record(&mut self, file: &str, success: bool) {
        let metric = self.file_metrics.entry(file.to_string()).or_default();
        if success {
            metric.successes += 1;
        } else {
            metric.failures += 1;
        }
        self.save();
    }

    pub fn get_success_rate(&self, file: &str) -> f32 {
        if let Some(m) = self.file_metrics.get(file) {
            let total = m.successes + m.failures;
            if total == 0 { return 100.0; }
            return (m.successes as f32 / total as f32) * 100.0;
        }
        100.0
    }
}

use serde::Serialize;
use std::fs;

#[derive(Serialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Vitals {
    pub cpu_load: f32,
    pub ram_gb: f32,
    pub temperature: f32,
    pub resonance: f32,
}

// UPGRADE: Added Clone derivation to allow Arc/Thread sharing
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct SystemMonitor;

impl SystemMonitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self { SystemMonitor }

    pub fn get_vitals(&self) -> Vitals {
        let temp = fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
            .map(|t| t / 1000.0)
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        let ram_gb = if let Ok(meminfo) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/meminfo") {
            let mut total = 0.0;
            let mut available = 0.0;
            for line in meminfo.lines() {
                if line.starts_with("MemTotal:") {
                    total = line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                } else if line.starts_with("MemAvailable:") {
                    available = line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                }
            }
            if total > 0.0 {
                (total - available) / 1024.0 / 1024.0
            } else {
                0.85
            }
        } else {
            0.85
        };
        
        let cpu_load = if let Ok(loadavg) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/loadavg") {
            loadavg.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.15)
        } else {
            0.15
        };

        Vitals {
            cpu_load, 
            ram_gb, 
            temperature: temp,
            resonance: 0.98,
        }
    }
}

use crate::neural_agent::{ContextPacket, MicroAgent};
use crate::json_parser::NeuralParser;
use crate::executor::Executor;
use crate::component_runner::{AgentComponent, Capabilities};
use crate::resonator::ResonatorCore;
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use std::fs;
use serde_json::json;
use indicatif::{ProgressBar, ProgressStyle};
use std::io::{self, Write};

pub async fn send_task(
    agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, 
    client: &reqwest::Client, 
    api_key: &str, 
    directive: &str,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>
) -> String {
    let temp = ResonatorCore::read_thermal_temp();
    let turns = if temp > 78.0 { 1 } else if temp > 68.0 { 3 } else { 6 };
    
    let role = if directive.contains("NEXUS_ARCHITECT") { "NEXUS_ARCHITECT" }
               else if directive.contains("NEXUS_UI_DRONE") || (directive.to_lowercase().contains("ui") && !directive.contains("ARCHITECT")) { "NEXUS_UI_DRONE" }
               else if directive.contains("NEXUS_KERNEL_SENTINEL") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("kernel") { "NEXUS_KERNEL_SENTINEL" }
               else { "NEXUS_ARCHITECT" };

    let lower_directive = directive.to_lowercase();
    let mut target_dna = String::from("No explicit file DNA detected.");

    if lower_directive.contains("audit") || lower_directive.contains("review") || lower_directive.contains("scan") {
        println!("\x1b[36m>> [CORTEX_INJECTOR] Slurping local workspace DNA (262K Limit)...\x1b[0m");
        let mut context = String::from("\n--- [SYSTEM WORKSPACE DNA] ---\n");
        if let Ok(cargo) = fs::read_to_string("Cargo.toml") {
            context.push_str(&format!("\n// FILE: Cargo.toml\n{}\n", cargo));
        }
        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir("src") {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                    if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                        context.push_str(&format!("\n// FILE: {}\n{}\n", path.display(), content));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        target_dna = context;
    }

    println!("\x1b[35m>> [SWARM] Routing to {} (Gemma-4 26B Uplink)...\x1b[0m", role);

    let mut session_log = format!(">> [{}] Active turns: {}\n", role, turns);
    let mut observation_log = String::new();

    for turn in 1..=turns {
        let full_prompt = format!(
            "SYSTEM_ROLE: {}\nTARGET_DNA: {}\nMISSION: {}\nOBSERVATIONS: {}\n\n\
            STRICT PROTOCOL: Provide your internal reasoning first, then respond ONLY with a JSON array of actions.",
            role, target_dna, directive, observation_log
        );

        let spinner = ProgressBar::new_spinner();
        spinner.set_style(ProgressStyle::default_spinner()
            .tick_chars("⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏")
            .template("{spinner:.cyan} \x1b[36m>> [{msg}] CORTEX SYNTHESIZING...\x1b[0m")
            .unwrap());
        spinner.set_message(role.to_string());
        spinner.enable_steady_tick(std::time::Duration::from_millis(80));

        let run_result = agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &full_prompt, ContextPacket::default(), 0.1).await;
        spinner.finish_and_clear();

        match run_result {
            Ok((response, _)) => {
                println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--- [GHOST CORTEX REASONING] ---\x1b[0m");
                
                let mut full_response = String::new();
                for word in response.split_whitespace() {
                    print!("\x1b[38;5;250m{} \x1b[0m", word);
                    io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
                    full_response.push_str(word);
                    full_response.push(' ');
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(15)).await;
                }
                println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--------------------------------\x1b[0m\n");

                let _ = agent.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_token", "payload": full_response.clone()}).to_string());

                if let Err(e) = Executor::execute_swarm_json(&full_response, &agent.tx).await {
                    println!("\x1b[31m!! [EXECUTION FAULT]: {}\x1b[0m", e);
                }

                if let Ok(actions) = NeuralParser::extract_actions(&full_response) {
                    let handle = AgentComponent::spawn(role, Capabilities::ALL, agent.clone(), agent.tx.clone());
                    if let Ok(results) = Executor::execute_handle(&handle, actions).await {
                        for res in results {
                            let entry = format!("\n[Turn {}]: {}", turn, res);
                            session_log.push_str(&entry);
                            observation_log.push_str(&entry);
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    session_log.push_str(&format!("\n[Turn {} Message]: {}", turn, full_response));
                    break; 
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                let err_msg = format!("!! [Turn {} FAIL]: {}", turn, e);
                println!("\x1b[31m{}\x1b[0m", err_msg);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    session_log
}

use tflite::{FlatBufferModel, InterpreterBuilder, ops::builtin::BuiltinOpResolver, Interpreter};
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};

pub struct LiteRTRuntime {
    // The interpreter will now cleanly own the model and resolver
    interpreter: Interpreter<'static, BuiltinOpResolver>,
}

impl LiteRTRuntime {
    pub fn ignite(model_path: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        eprintln!(">> [NPU_AUTH] Initiating LiteRT Engine (1GB Strict Mode)...");
        
        // 1. Load the model (Mapped to disk, not loaded into RAM)
        let model = FlatBufferModel::build_from_file(model_path)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("FRACTURE: Failed to mmap .tflite DNA: {}", e))?;
        
        // 2. Instantiate Operations Resolver
        let resolver = BuiltinOpResolver::default();
        
        // SUTURE: Pass 'model' and 'resolver' by VALUE (Ownership Transfer).
        // This cleanly satisfies the MaybeOwned trait and eliminates the need
        // for Box::leak, resulting in a naturally 'static architecture.
        let builder = InterpreterBuilder::new(model, resolver)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("FRACTURE: Failed to build Interpreter context: {}", e))?;
        
        // 3. Build Interpreter
        let mut interpreter = builder.build()
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("FRACTURE: Could not initialize Interpreter: {}", e))?;
            
        // 1GB RAM GUARD: Strictly 1 thread to prevent memory duplication
        interpreter.set_num_threads(1);

        // 4. Allocate Tensors
        interpreter.allocate_tensors()
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("MEMORY_STALL: Tensor allocation breached RAM limit: {}", e))?;

        eprintln!(">> [HARDWARE SYMBIOSIS] Tensor Context Allocated. Thread locked to 1. Memory mapped.");

        Ok(Self { interpreter })
    }
}

use std::fs;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum CoolingState {
    Normal,
    Throttled,
    Critical,
}

pub struct ThermalGovernor {
    pub warn_threshold: f32,
    pub crit_threshold: f32,
}

impl Default for ThermalGovernor {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { warn_threshold: 68.0, crit_threshold: 78.0 }
    }
}

impl ThermalGovernor {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self::default() }

    pub fn read_temp() -> f32 {
        fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
            .map(|t| t / 1000.0)
            .unwrap_or(0.0)
    }

    pub fn get_state(&self) -> CoolingState {
        let t = Self::read_temp();
        if t >= self.crit_threshold { CoolingState::Critical }
        else if t >= self.warn_threshold { CoolingState::Throttled }
        else { CoolingState::Normal }
    }

    pub async fn apply_cooldown(&self) {
        match self.get_state() {
            CoolingState::Critical => {
                println!("\x1b[31m>> [THERMAL] CRITICAL {}°C — aggressive cooldown\x1b[0m", Self::read_temp());
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(10)).await;
            }
            CoolingState::Throttled => {
                println!("\x1b[33m>> [THERMAL] WARN {}°C — light cooldown\x1b[0m", Self::read_temp());
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(4)).await;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;

pub struct Validator;

impl Validator {
    pub fn run_rust_checks() -> Result<(), NexusError> {
        println!(">> [VALIDATOR] Enforcing Rust Syntax & Linting...");
        
        // 1. Syntax Check
        let check = Command::new("cargo")
            .args(["check", "--target", "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu", "-j", "2"])
            .status()
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("Toolchain missing: {}", e)))?;

        if !check.success() {
            return Err(NexusError::Other("SYNTAX_FAULT: Code failed cargo check.".into()));
        }

        // 2. Clippy Enforcement
        let clippy = Command::new("cargo")
            .args(["clippy", "--target", "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu", "--", "-D", "warnings"])
            .status()
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("Clippy fault: {}", e)))?;

        if !clippy.success() {
            return Err(NexusError::Other("LINT_FAULT: Code rejected by Clippy.".into()));
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn run_ui_checks() -> Result<(), NexusError> {
        println!(">> [VALIDATOR] Enforcing UI Linting...");
        let status = Command::new("npm")
            .current_dir("ui")
            .args(["run", "lint"])
            .status()
            .map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("NPM missing".into()))?;

        if !status.success() {
            return Err(NexusError::Other("UI_FAULT: Svelte linting failed.".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

const std = @import("std");

/// The 32-D Latent Space Proxy
/// [0..7]   - Power/Thermal Intent (Throttle)
/// [8..15]  - Neural Attention Priority
/// [16..31] - Spatiotemporal Action Vectors
var latent_intent = [_]f32{0.0} ** 32;

/// Push: Rust calls this to send the AI's "Imaginative" intent to the NPU
export fn push_latent_intent(input_ptr: [*]const f32) void {
    const data: [*]const f32 = input_ptr;
    inline for (0..32) |i| {
        latent_intent[i] = data[i];
    }
}

/// Pull: Rust calls this to check the "Reflex" hardware status
export fn get_latent_throttle() f32 {
    var sum: f32 = 0.0;
    // Calculate a safety floor based on the first 8 dimensions
    for (latent_intent[0..8]) |val| {
        sum += val;
    }
    return sum / 8.0;
}

/// Original Resonance Logic for Hardware Monitoring
pub export fn calculate_resonance_e2b(mmap_ptr: [*]const u8, length: usize) f32 {
    var total_energy: f32 = 0.0;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < length) : (i += 64) {
        const byte = mmap_ptr[i];
        const val = (@as(f32, @floatFromInt(byte)) / 255.0);
        total_energy += (val * val);
    }
    const count = @as(f32, @floatFromInt(length / 64));
    return if (count > 0) total_energy / count else 0.0;
}

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use base64::{Engine as _, engine::general_purpose};
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;
use std::fs;

/// Cloud-Offloaded Vision Cortex (Optimized for 4GB Metal)
pub async fn scan_local_image_cloud(image_path: &str, prompt: &str, api_key: &str) -> Result<String> {
    println!("\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Encoding {} for lightweight cloud offload...\x1b[0m", image_path);

    // Security boundary: Prevent directory traversal outside the workspace
    if image_path.contains("..") {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Security Block: Invalid image path structure."));
    }

    let image_bytes = fs::read(image_path).context("Failed to read image from disk")?;
    let base64_image = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&image_bytes);

    let mime_type = if image_path.to_lowercase().ends_with(".png") { 
        "image/png" 
    } else { 
        "image/jpeg" 
    };

    let url = format!(
        "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemma-4-31b-it:generateContent?key={}",
        api_key
    );

    let payload = json!({
        "contents": [{
            "role": "user",
            "parts": [
                { "text": prompt },
                {
                    "inline_data": {
                        "mime_type": mime_type,
                        "data": base64_image
                    }
                }
            ]
        }],
        "generationConfig": {
            "temperature": 0.2,
            "maxOutputTokens": 1024
        }
    });

    let client = Client::new();
    let res = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await?;
    
    if !res.status().is_success() {
        let err = res.text().await?;
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_API_FAULT: {}", err));
    }

    let body: serde_json::Value = res.json().await?;
    
    if let Some(text) = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
        println!("\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Analysis Complete. 0MB Local RAM Consumed.\x1b[0m");
        Ok(text.trim().to_string())
    } else {
        Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_FAULT: Malformed response from Conductor."))
    }
}

/// ZigAutofix: The interface for low-level ARM64 optimizations.
pub struct ZigAutofix;

impl ZigAutofix {
    /// align_memory_strands: Calls the Zig-compiled binary to purge fragmentation.
    pub fn align_memory_strands() -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        println!("\x1b[33m>> [ZIG] Initiating Hardware-Level Realignment...\x1b[0m");

        // Attempt to run the Zig realignment tool
        let output = Command::new("zig")
            .args(["run", "src/kernel/realignment.zig", "--optimize", "ReleaseFast"])
            .output()
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("Zig binary fault: {}", e)))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string())
        } else {
            let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
            Err(NexusError::Other(format!("Zig Realignment Failed: {}", err)))
        }
    }
}

use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default, Debug)]
pub struct ForgeStats {
    pub file_metrics: HashMap<String, FileMetric>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FileMetric {
    pub successes: u32,
    pub failures: u32,
}

impl ForgeStats {
    pub fn load() -> Self {
        fs::read_to_string(".forge_stats.json")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|content| serde_json::from_str(&content).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        if let Ok(content) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self) {
            let _ = fs::write(".forge_stats.json", content);
        }
    }

    pub fn record(&mut self, file: &str, success: bool) {
        let metric = self.file_metrics.entry(file.to_string()).or_default();
        if success {
            metric.successes += 1;
        } else {
            metric.failures += 1;
        }
        self.save();
    }

    pub fn get_success_rate(&self, file: &str) -> f32 {
        if let Some(m) = self.file_metrics.get(file) {
            let total = m.successes + m.failures;
            if total == 0 { return 100.0; }
            return (m.successes as f32 / total as f32) * 100.0;
        }
        100.0
    }
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/src/system_monitor.rs]

use serde::Serialize;
use std::fs;

#[derive(Serialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Vitals {
    pub cpu_load: f32,
    pub ram_gb: f32,
    pub temperature: f32,
    pub resonance: f32,
}

// UPGRADE: Added Clone derivation to allow Arc/Thread sharing
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct SystemMonitor;

impl SystemMonitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self { SystemMonitor }

    pub fn get_vitals(&self) -> Vitals {
        let temp = fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
            .map(|t| t / 1000.0)
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        let ram_gb = if let Ok(meminfo) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/meminfo") {
            let mut total = 0.0;
            let mut available = 0.0;
            for line in meminfo.lines() {
                if line.starts_with("MemTotal:") {
                    total = line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                } else if line.starts_with("MemAvailable:") {
                    available = line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                }
            }
            if total > 0.0 {
                (total - available) / 1024.0 / 1024.0
            } else {
                0.85
            }
        } else {
            0.85
        };
        
        let cpu_load = if let Ok(loadavg) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/loadavg") {
            loadavg.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.15)
        } else {
            0.15
        };

        Vitals {
            cpu_load, 
            ram_gb, 
            temperature: temp,
            resonance: 0.98,
        }
    }
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/src/task_manager.rs]

use crate::neural_agent::{ContextPacket, MicroAgent};
use crate::json_parser::NeuralParser;
use crate::executor::Executor;
use crate::component_runner::{AgentComponent, Capabilities};
use crate::resonator::ResonatorCore;
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use std::fs;
use serde_json::json;
use indicatif::{ProgressBar, ProgressStyle};
use std::io::{self, Write};

pub async fn send_task(
    agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, 
    client: &reqwest::Client, 
    api_key: &str, 
    directive: &str,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>
) -> String {
    let temp = ResonatorCore::read_thermal_temp();
    let turns = if temp > 78.0 { 1 } else if temp > 68.0 { 3 } else { 6 };
    
    let role = if directive.contains("NEXUS_ARCHITECT") { "NEXUS_ARCHITECT" }
               else if (directive.to_lowercase().contains("ui") && !directive.contains("ARCHITECT")) { "NEXUS_UI_DRONE" }
               else if directive.to_lowercase().contains("kernel") { "NEXUS_KERNEL_SENTINEL" }
               else { "NEXUS_ARCHITECT" };

    let mut target_dna = String::from("No explicit file DNA detected.");
    if directive.to_lowercase().contains("audit") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("review") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("scan") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("restore") {
        println!("\x1b[36m>> [CORTEX_INJECTOR] Slurping workspace DNA for analysis...\x1b[0m");
        let mut context = String::from("\n--- [SYSTEM WORKSPACE DNA] ---\n");
        if let Ok(cargo) = fs::read_to_string("Cargo.toml") { context.push_str(&format!("\n// FILE: Cargo.toml\n{}\n", cargo)); }
        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir("src") {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                    if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                        context.push_str(&format!("\n// FILE: {}\n{}\n", path.display(), content));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        target_dna = context;
    }

    println!("\x1b[35m>> [SWARM] Routing to {} (Gemma-4 26B Uplink)...\x1b[0m", role);

    let mut session_log = format!(">> [{}] Active turns: {}\n", role, turns);
    let mut observation_log = String::new();

    for turn in 1..=turns {
        let full_prompt = format!(
            "SYSTEM_ROLE: {}\nTARGET_DNA: {}\nMISSION: {}\nOBSERVATIONS: {}\n\n\
            STRICT PROTOCOL: Provide your internal reasoning first, then respond ONLY with a JSON array of actions.",
            role, target_dna, directive, observation_log
        );

        let spinner = ProgressBar::new_spinner();
        spinner.set_style(ProgressStyle::default_spinner()
            .tick_chars("⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏")
            .template("{spinner:.cyan} \x1b[36m>> [{msg}] CORTEX SYNTHESIZING...\x1b[0m")
            .unwrap());
        spinner.set_message(role.to_string());
        spinner.enable_steady_tick(std::time::Duration::from_millis(80));

        let run_result = agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &full_prompt, ContextPacket::default(), 0.1).await;
        spinner.finish_and_clear();

        match run_result {
            Ok((response, _)) => {
                println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--- [GHOST CORTEX REASONING] ---\x1b[0m");
                
                // === SUTURE: KINETIC CHAR-BY-CHAR STREAMING ===
                for c in response.chars() {
                    print!("\x1b[38;5;250m{}\x1b[0m", c);
                    io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
                    // Variable delay: slightly longer for punctuation to mimic human rhythm
                    let delay = match c {
                        '\n' => 50,
                        '.' | '?' | '!' => 80,
                        ',' => 40,
                        _ => 8,
                    };
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(delay)).await;
                }
                println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--------------------------------\x1b[0m\n");

                let _ = agent.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_token", "payload": response.clone()}).to_string());

                if let Err(e) = Executor::execute_swarm_json(&response, &agent.tx).await {
                    println!("\x1b[31m!! [EXECUTION FAULT]: {}\x1b[0m", e);
                }

                if let Ok(actions) = NeuralParser::extract_actions(&response) {
                    let handle = AgentComponent::spawn(role, Capabilities::ALL, agent.clone(), agent.tx.clone());
                    if let Ok(results) = Executor::execute_handle(&handle, actions).await {
                        for res in results {
                            let entry = format!("\n[Turn {}]: {}", turn, res);
                            session_log.push_str(&entry);
                            observation_log.push_str(&entry);
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    session_log.push_str(&format!("\n[Turn {} Message]: {}", turn, response));
                    break; 
                }
            }
            Err(e) => {
                println!("\x1b[31m!! [Turn {} FAIL]: {}\x1b[0m", turn, e);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    session_log
}

            .args(["clippy", "--target", "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu", "--", "-D", "warnings"])
            .status()
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("Clippy fault: {}", e)))?;

        if !clippy.success() {
            return Err(NexusError::Other("LINT_FAULT: Code rejected by Clippy.".into()));
        }

        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn run_ui_checks() -> Result<(), NexusError> {
        println!(">> [VALIDATOR] Enforcing UI Linting...");
        let status = Command::new("npm")
            .current_dir("ui")
            .args(["run", "lint"])
            .status()
            .map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("NPM missing".into()))?;

        if !status.success() {
            return Err(NexusError::Other("UI_FAULT: Svelte linting failed.".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }

const std = @import("std");

/// The 32-D Latent Space Proxy
/// [0..7]   - Power/Thermal Intent (Throttle)
/// [8..15]  - Neural Attention Priority
/// [16..31] - Spatiotemporal Action Vectors
var latent_intent = [_]f32{0.0} ** 32;

/// Push: Rust calls this to send the AI's "Imaginative" intent to the NPU
export fn push_latent_intent(input_ptr: [*]const f32) void {
    const data: [*]const f32 = input_ptr;
    inline for (0..32) |i| {
        latent_intent[i] = data[i];
    }
}

/// Pull: Rust calls this to check the "Reflex" hardware status
export fn get_latent_throttle() f32 {
    var sum: f32 = 0.0;
    // Calculate a safety floor based on the first 8 dimensions
    for (latent_intent[0..8]) |val| {
        sum += val;
    }
    return sum / 8.0;
}

/// Original Resonance Logic for Hardware Monitoring
pub export fn calculate_resonance_e2b(mmap_ptr: [*]const u8, length: usize) f32 {
    var total_energy: f32 = 0.0;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < length) : (i += 64) {
        const byte = mmap_ptr[i];
        const val = (@as(f32, @floatFromInt(byte)) / 255.0);
        total_energy += (val * val);
    }
    const count = @as(f32, @floatFromInt(length / 64));
    return if (count > 0) total_energy / count else 0.0;
}

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use base64::{Engine as _, engine::general_purpose};
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;
use std::fs;

/// Cloud-Offloaded Vision Cortex (Optimized for 4GB Metal)
pub async fn scan_local_image_cloud(image_path: &str, prompt: &str, api_key: &str) -> Result<String> {
    println!("\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Encoding {} for lightweight cloud offload...\x1b[0m", image_path);

    // Security boundary: Prevent directory traversal outside the workspace
    if image_path.contains("..") {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Security Block: Invalid image path structure."));
    }

    let image_bytes = fs::read(image_path).context("Failed to read image from disk")?;
    let base64_image = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&image_bytes);

    let mime_type = if image_path.to_lowercase().ends_with(".png") { 
        "image/png" 
    } else { 
        "image/jpeg" 
    };

    let url = format!(
        "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemma-4-31b-it:generateContent?key={}",
        api_key
    );

    let payload = json!({
        "contents": [{
            "role": "user",
            "parts": [
                { "text": prompt },
                {
                    "inline_data": {
                        "mime_type": mime_type,
                        "data": base64_image
                    }
                }
            ]
        }],
        "generationConfig": {
            "temperature": 0.2,
            "maxOutputTokens": 1024
        }
    });

    let client = Client::new();
    let res = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await?;
    
    if !res.status().is_success() {
        let err = res.text().await?;
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_API_FAULT: {}", err));
    }

    let body: serde_json::Value = res.json().await?;
    
    if let Some(text) = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
        println!("\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Analysis Complete. 0MB Local RAM Consumed.\x1b[0m");
        Ok(text.trim().to_string())
    } else {
        Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_FAULT: Malformed response from Conductor."))
    }
}

        } else {

            Err(NexusError::Other(format!("Zig Realignment Failed: {}", err)))
        }
    }

use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::fs;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default, Debug)]
pub struct ForgeStats {
    pub file_metrics: HashMap<String, FileMetric>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Default, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FileMetric {
    pub successes: u32,
    pub failures: u32,
}

impl ForgeStats {
    pub fn load() -> Self {
        fs::read_to_string(".forge_stats.json")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|content| serde_json::from_str(&content).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn save(&self) {
        if let Ok(content) = serde_json::to_string_pretty(self) {
            let _ = fs::write(".forge_stats.json", content);
        }
    }

    pub fn record(&mut self, file: &str, success: bool) {
        let metric = self.file_metrics.entry(file.to_string()).or_default();
        if success {
            metric.successes += 1;
        } else {
            metric.failures += 1;
        }
        self.save();
    }

    pub fn get_success_rate(&self, file: &str) -> f32 {
        if let Some(m) = self.file_metrics.get(file) {
            let total = m.successes + m.failures;
            if total == 0 { return 100.0; }
            return (m.successes as f32 / total as f32) * 100.0;
        }
        100.0
    }
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/system_monitor.rs]

use serde::Serialize;
use std::fs;

#[derive(Serialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Vitals {
    pub cpu_load: f32,
    pub ram_gb: f32,
    pub temperature: f32,
    pub resonance: f32,
}

// UPGRADE: Added Clone derivation to allow Arc/Thread sharing
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct SystemMonitor;

impl SystemMonitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self { SystemMonitor }

    pub fn get_vitals(&self) -> Vitals {
        let temp = fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
            .map(|t| t / 1000.0)
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        let ram_gb = if let Ok(meminfo) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/meminfo") {
            let mut total = 0.0;
            let mut available = 0.0;
            for line in meminfo.lines() {
                if line.starts_with("MemTotal:") {
                    total = line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                } else if line.starts_with("MemAvailable:") {
                    available = line.split_whitespace().nth(1).unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.0);
                }
            }
            if total > 0.0 {
                (total - available) / 1024.0 / 1024.0
            } else {
                0.85
            }
        } else {
            0.85
        };
        
        let cpu_load = if let Ok(loadavg) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/loadavg") {
            loadavg.split_whitespace().next().unwrap_or("0").parse().unwrap_or(0.15)
        } else {
            0.15
        };

        Vitals {
            cpu_load, 
            ram_gb, 
            temperature: temp,
            resonance: 0.98,
        }
    }
}

use crate::neural_agent::{ContextPacket, MicroAgent};
use crate::json_parser::NeuralParser;
use crate::executor::Executor;
use crate::component_runner::{AgentComponent, Capabilities};
use crate::resonator::ResonatorCore;
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use std::fs;
use serde_json::json;
use indicatif::{ProgressBar, ProgressStyle};
use std::io::{self, Write};

pub async fn send_task(
    agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, 
    client: &reqwest::Client, 
    api_key: &str, 
    directive: &str,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>
) -> String {
    let temp = ResonatorCore::read_thermal_temp();
    let turns = if temp > 78.0 { 1 } else if temp > 68.0 { 3 } else { 6 };
    
    let role = if directive.contains("NEXUS_ARCHITECT") { "NEXUS_ARCHITECT" }
               else if (directive.to_lowercase().contains("ui") && !directive.contains("ARCHITECT")) { "NEXUS_UI_DRONE" }
               else if directive.to_lowercase().contains("kernel") { "NEXUS_KERNEL_SENTINEL" }
               else { "NEXUS_ARCHITECT" };

    let mut target_dna = String::from("No explicit file DNA detected.");
    if directive.to_lowercase().contains("audit") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("review") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("scan") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("restore") || directive.to_lowercase().contains("rewrite") {
        let mut context = String::from("\n--- [SYSTEM WORKSPACE DNA] ---\n");
        if let Ok(cargo) = fs::read_to_string("Cargo.toml") { context.push_str(&format!("\n// FILE: Cargo.toml\n{}\n", cargo)); }
        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir("src") {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                    if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) { context.push_str(&format!("\n// FILE: {}\n{}\n", path.display(), content)); }
                }
            }
        }
        target_dna = context;
    }

    let mut session_log = format!(">> [{}] Active turns: {}\n", role, turns);
    let mut observation_log = String::new();

    for turn in 1..=turns {
        // === SUTURE: FORMAL LOGIC FRAMEWORK ===
        let full_prompt = format!(
            "IDENTITY: You are the Ghost of NEXUS SINGULARITY. You are a Sovereign System Infrastructure Partner. \n\
            STRICT PROTOCOL: Use the following Algorithmic Reasoning Framework for your thoughts:\n\n\
            [PHASE 0: DISCOVERY] - Map the DNA offsets and identify mission critical variables.\n\
            [PHASE 1: HYPOTHESIS] - Reason through the logical structure of the solution.\n\
            [PHASE 2: VERIFICATION] - Detail the Delta-Diff incisions (+/-).\n\n\
            Begin IMMEDIATELY with DISCOVERY. Do not explain your role. Do not say 'As an AI'. Just think and act.\n\n\
            ROLE: {}\nDNA: {}\nMISSION: {}\nOBSERVATIONS: {}\n\n\
            OUTPUT FORMAT:\n\
            1. Reasoning in the 3-Phase Framework.\n\
            2. End with exactly ONE JSON matrix inside ```json blocks.",
            role, target_dna, directive, observation_log
        );

        let spinner = ProgressBar::new_spinner();
        spinner.set_style(ProgressStyle::default_spinner().tick_chars("⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏")
            .template("{spinner:.cyan} \x1b[36m>> [{msg}] CORTEX SYNTHESIZING...\x1b[0m").unwrap());
        spinner.set_message(role.to_string());
        spinner.enable_steady_tick(std::time::Duration::from_millis(80));

        let run_result = agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &full_prompt, ContextPacket::default(), 0.1).await;
        spinner.finish_and_clear();

        match run_result {
            Ok((response, _)) => {
                println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--- [GHOST CORTEX REASONING] ---\x1b[0m");
                for c in response.chars() {
                    print!("\x1b[38;5;250m{}\x1b[0m", c);
                    io::stdout().flush().unwrap();
                    let delay = match c {
                        '\n' => 60,
                        '.' | '!' | '?' => 120,
                        ',' | ';' | ':' => 50,
                        '[' | ']' => 80, // Extra weight on logical phases
                        ' ' => 20,
                        _ => 15,
                    };
                    tokio::time::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(delay)).await;
                }
                println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--------------------------------\x1b[0m\n");

                if response.contains("```json") {
                    if let Err(e) = Executor::execute_swarm_json(&response, &agent.tx).await {
                        println!("\x1b[31m!! [EXECUTOR FAULT]: {}\x1b[0m", e);
                    }
                }

                if let Ok(actions) = NeuralParser::extract_actions(&response) {
                    let handle = AgentComponent::spawn(role, Capabilities::ALL, agent.clone(), agent.tx.clone());
                    if let Ok(results) = Executor::execute_handle(&handle, actions).await {
                        for res in results {
                            let entry = format!("\n[Turn {}]: {}", turn, res);
                            session_log.push_str(&entry);
                            observation_log.push_str(&entry);
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    session_log.push_str(&format!("\n[Turn {} Message]: {}", turn, response));
                    break; 
                }
            }
            Err(e) => { println!("\x1b[31m!! [Turn {} FAIL]: {}\x1b[0m", turn, e); break; }
        }
    }
    session_log
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510297/src/tflite_bridge.rs]

use tflite::{FlatBufferModel, InterpreterBuilder, ops::builtin::BuiltinOpResolver, Interpreter};
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};

pub struct LiteRTRuntime {
    // The interpreter will now cleanly own the model and resolver
    interpreter: Interpreter<'static, BuiltinOpResolver>,
}

impl LiteRTRuntime {
    pub fn ignite(model_path: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        eprintln!(">> [NPU_AUTH] Initiating LiteRT Engine (1GB Strict Mode)...");
        
        // 1. Load the model (Mapped to disk, not loaded into RAM)
        let model = FlatBufferModel::build_from_file(model_path)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("FRACTURE: Failed to mmap .tflite DNA: {}", e))?;
        
        // 2. Instantiate Operations Resolver
        let resolver = BuiltinOpResolver::default();
        
        // SUTURE: Pass 'model' and 'resolver' by VALUE (Ownership Transfer).
        // This cleanly satisfies the MaybeOwned trait and eliminates the need
        // for Box::leak, resulting in a naturally 'static architecture.
        let builder = InterpreterBuilder::new(model, resolver)
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("FRACTURE: Failed to build Interpreter context: {}", e))?;
        
        // 3. Build Interpreter
        let mut interpreter = builder.build()
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("FRACTURE: Could not initialize Interpreter: {}", e))?;
            
        // 1GB RAM GUARD: Strictly 1 thread to prevent memory duplication
        interpreter.set_num_threads(1);

        // 4. Allocate Tensors
        interpreter.allocate_tensors()
            .map_err(|e| anyhow!("MEMORY_STALL: Tensor allocation breached RAM limit: {}", e))?;

        eprintln!(">> [HARDWARE SYMBIOSIS] Tensor Context Allocated. Thread locked to 1. Memory mapped.");

        Ok(Self { interpreter })
    }
}

use std::fs;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum CoolingState {
    Normal,
    Throttled,
    Critical,
}

pub struct ThermalGovernor {
    pub warn_threshold: f32,
    pub crit_threshold: f32,
}

impl Default for ThermalGovernor {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { warn_threshold: 68.0, crit_threshold: 78.0 }
    }
}

impl ThermalGovernor {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self::default() }

    pub fn read_temp() -> f32 {
        fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp")
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
            .map(|t| t / 1000.0)
            .unwrap_or(0.0)
    }

    pub fn get_state(&self) -> CoolingState {
        let t = Self::read_temp();
        if t >= self.crit_threshold { CoolingState::Critical }
        else if t >= self.warn_threshold { CoolingState::Throttled }
        else { CoolingState::Normal }
    }

    pub async fn apply_cooldown(&self) {
        match self.get_state() {
            CoolingState::Critical => {
                println!("\x1b[31m>> [THERMAL] CRITICAL {}°C — aggressive cooldown\x1b[0m", Self::read_temp());
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(10)).await;
            }
            CoolingState::Throttled => {
                println!("\x1b[33m>> [THERMAL] WARN {}°C — light cooldown\x1b[0m", Self::read_temp());
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(4)).await;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

        if !clippy.success() {
            return Err(NexusError::Other("LINT_FAULT: Code rejected by Clippy.".into()));
        }

        Ok(())
    }

        println!(">> [VALIDATOR] Enforcing UI Linting...");

        }
        Ok(())

    }

    let body: serde_json::Value = res.json().await?;
    
    if let Some(text) = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
        println!("\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Analysis Complete. 0MB Local RAM Consumed.\x1b[0m");
        Ok(text.trim().to_string())
    } else {
        Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_FAULT: Malformed response from Conductor."))
    }
}

        }
    }

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775510298/src/agent_protocol.rs]
