use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use serde_json::Value;
use tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender;
use std::process::Command;
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::component_runner::AgentHandle;

pub struct Executor;

impl Executor {
    pub async fn execute_handle(
        _handle: &AgentHandle,
        _actions: Vec<AgentAction>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<String>, NexusError> {
        Ok(vec![">> [AGENT]: Action logged via component handle.".into()])
    }

    pub async fn execute_swarm_json(json_text: &str, tx: &Sender<String>) -> Result<Vec<String>, NexusError> {
        let mut observations = Vec::new();
        let start = json_text.find('[').unwrap_or(0);
        let end = json_text.rfind(']').unwrap_or(json_text.len().saturating_sub(1));
        let sanitized_json = if start <= end { &json_text[start..=end] } else { json_text };

        if let Ok(actions) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<Value>>(sanitized_json) {
            println!("\x1b[32m>> [EXECUTOR] Action Matrix Engaged.\x1b[0m");
            let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs();

            for action in actions {
                let op = action.get("action").or_else(|| action.get("op")).and_then(|a| a.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_lowercase();
                let target = action.get("target").or_else(|| action.get("file")).or_else(|| action.get("path")).and_then(|a| a.as_str()).unwrap_or("GLOBAL");
                
                // --- READ PROTOCOL ---
                if op == "read_file" || op == "read" {
                    match fs::read_to_string(target) {
                        Ok(content) => {
                            observations.push(format!("FILE_READ_SUCCESS: {}\nCONTENT:\n{}", target, content));
                            println!("\x1b[34m>> [FS] Read success: {}\x1b[0m", target);
                        },
                        Err(e) => observations.push(format!("FILE_READ_ERROR: {} - {}", target, e)),
                    }
                }
                // --- WRITE PROTOCOL ---
                else if op.contains("file") || op == "patch" || op == "modify" {
                    let backup_dir = format!(".lazarus_vault/{}", timestamp);
                    let _ = fs::create_dir_all(&backup_dir);
                    let _ = Command::new("cp").args(["-r", "src", &backup_dir]).output();
                    
                    let content = action.get("content").or_else(|| action.get("code")).and_then(|c| c.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                    if !content.is_empty() {
                        if let Some(parent) = Path::new(target).parent() { let _ = fs::create_dir_all(parent); }
                        match fs::write(target, content) {
                            Ok(_) => {
                                observations.push(format!("FILE_WRITE_SUCCESS: {}", target));
                                println!("\x1b[32m>> [LAZARUS] Snapshot {} secured. [FS] Updated: {}\x1b[0m", timestamp, target);
                            },
                            Err(e) => observations.push(format!("FILE_WRITE_ERROR: {} - {}", target, e)),
                        }
                    }
                }
                // --- EXEC PROTOCOL ---
                else if op.contains("command") || op.contains("shell") || op == "run" {
                    let cmd = action.get("command").or_else(|| action.get("cmd")).or_else(|| action.get("args")).and_then(|c| c.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                    if !cmd.is_empty() {
                        println!("\x1b[33m>> [EXEC] {}\x1b[0m", cmd);
                        let output = Command::new("sh").args(["-c", cmd]).output();
                        match output {
                            Ok(out) => {
                                let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
                                let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr);
                                observations.push(format!("COMMAND_RESULT:\nSTDOUT: {}\nSTDERR: {}", stdout, stderr));
                                if !stdout.is_empty() { println!("\x1b[38;5;244m{}\x1b[0m", stdout.trim()); }
                                if !stderr.is_empty() { println!("\x1b[31m{}\x1b[0m", stderr.trim()); }
                            },
                            Err(e) => observations.push(format!("COMMAND_FAULT: {}", e)),
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(observations)
    }
}

    println!(">> [AUTOFIX] Correlating UI faults with Gemma-3...");

        "Fix the Svelte frontend. Force mode: {}. Provide a 3-step repair plan.",
        force
    );

                }
            }
        }

use std::process::Command;
use chrono::{DateTime, Utc, Duration};

pub fn check_cluster_sync() -> bool {
    let output = Command::new("gh")
        .args(&["issue", "view", "1", "--json", "comments", "-q", ".comments[-1].createdAt"])
        .output();

    if let Ok(out) = output {
        let timestamp_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout).trim().to_string();
        if let Ok(last_heartbeat) = timestamp_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {
            let drift = Utc::now() - last_heartbeat;
            return drift < Duration::try_minutes(5).unwrap();
        }
    }
    false
}

use anyhow::Result;
use serde_json::json;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;

/// HiveMind now uses the existing tokio broadcast bus instead of Redis.
/// Saves ~50MB RAM and removes the Redis process dependency entirely.
pub struct HiveMind {
    tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
}

impl HiveMind {
    pub fn new(tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Self {
        Self { tx }
    }

    pub async fn dispatch_task(&self, drone: &str, task: &str, params: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let payload = json!({
            "type": "HIVE_DISPATCH",
            "drone": drone,
            "task": task,
            "params": params,
            "timestamp": chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339()
        });

        self.tx.send(payload.to_string())
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Broadcast send failed: {}", e))?;

        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn subscribe(&self) -> broadcast::Receiver<String> {
        self.tx.subscribe()
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;

pub struct Inquisitor;

impl Inquisitor {
    /// audit_ui: Runs the actual Svelte build and captures the REAL error.
    pub fn audit_ui() -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        println!("\x1b[33m>> [INQUISITOR] Executing UI Build Interrogation...\x1b[0m");
        
        // We use output() instead of status() to capture the text
        let output = Command::new("npm")
            .args(["run", "build"])
            .current_dir("ui")
            .output()
            .map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("NPM binary not found in path".into()))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            Ok("NOMINAL".into())
        } else {
            let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string();
            let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string();
            // Combine both because some builders output errors to stdout
            Ok(format!("STDOUT:\n{}\nSTDERR:\n{}", stdout, stderr))
        }
    }

    pub fn audit_backend() -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        let output = Command::new("cargo")
            .args(["check"])
            .output()
            .map_err(|_| NexusError::Other("Cargo not found".into()))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            Ok("NOMINAL".into())
        } else {
            Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string())
        }
    }
}

pub struct Janitor;

impl Janitor {
    pub async fn start_background_maintenance(state: Arc<AppState>) {
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let governor = ThermalGovernor::new();
            loop {
                governor.apply_cooldown().await;
                let vitals = state.monitor.get_vitals();
                // UPGRADE: Fixed logic error. cpu_load is a fraction, so it should be < 0.15, not < 15.0
                if vitals.cpu_load < 0.15 && governor.get_state() == crate::thermal_governor::CoolingState::Normal {
                    println!(">> [JANITOR] Low load + nominal temp — running maintenance...");
                }
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
            }
        });
    }
}

use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use serde_json::Value;
use regex::Regex;

pub struct NeuralParser;

impl NeuralParser {
    pub fn extract_actions(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentAction>, NexusError> {
        let mut actions = Vec::new();
        
        // 1. Remove Sovereign Thought Blocks (<|think|>, <|thought|>, <|channel|>)
        let thought_re = Regex::new(r"(?s)<\|(?:think|thought|channel)>.*?<\|(?:end|channel)\|?>").unwrap();
        let stripped_text = thought_re.replace_all(text, "");
        
        // 2. Revert HTML entities
        let unescaped_text = stripped_text.replace("&quot;", "\"").replace("&amp;", "&");
        
        // 3. Locate the outermost array [ ... ]
        if let (Some(start), Some(end)) = (unescaped_text.find('['), unescaped_text.rfind(']')) {
            if start < end {
                let array_str = &unescaped_text[start..=end];
                
                // Attempt direct array parsing
                if let Ok(batch) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<AgentAction>>(array_str) {
                    return Ok(batch);
                }
                
                // Fallback: Try parsing as generic Value array to filter valid actions
                if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(array_str) {
                    if let Some(arr) = val.as_array() {
                        for item in arr {
                            if let Ok(action) = serde_json::from_value::<AgentAction>(item.clone()) {
                                actions.push(action);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if actions.is_empty() {
            Err(NexusError::Other("DNA_TRANSLATION_FAILURE: Bridge could not bind actions to schema.".into()))
        } else {
            Ok(actions)
        }
    }
}

use std::fmt;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum Severity {
    Critical, // CVSS 9.0-10.0
    High,     // CVSS 7.0-8.9
    Medium,   // CVSS 4.0-6.9
    Low,      // CVSS 0.1-3.9
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum KernelError {
    VmoCloneFailed { parent: u32, size: usize },
    VmarMapFailed { vmar_handle: u32, size: usize },
    InvalidHandle(u32),
    AlignmentAnomaly { address: usize },
    SecurityViolation { message: String, cvss: f32 },
}

impl KernelError {
    pub fn severity(&self) -> Severity {
        match self {
            Self::SecurityViolation { cvss, .. } => {
                if *cvss >= 9.0 { Severity::Critical }
                else if *cvss >= 7.0 { Severity::High }
                else { Severity::Medium }
            },
            Self::VmarMapFailed { .. } => Severity::High,
            Self::VmoCloneFailed { .. } => Severity::High,
            Self::AlignmentAnomaly { .. } => Severity::Medium,
            Self::InvalidHandle(_) => Severity::Low,
        }
    }
}

impl fmt::Display for KernelError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        let label = match self.severity() {
            Severity::Critical => "![CRITICAL]!",
            Severity::High => "[HIGH]",
            Severity::Medium => "[MEDIUM]",
            Severity::Low => "[LOW]",
        };
        match self {
            Self::VmoCloneFailed { parent, size } => write!(f, "{} VMO_CLONE_FAIL: parent={} size={}", label, parent, size),
            Self::VmarMapFailed { vmar_handle, size } => write!(f, "{} VMAR_MAP_FAIL: handle=0x{:x} size={}", label, vmar_handle, size),
            Self::InvalidHandle(h) => write!(f, "{} INVALID_HANDLE: 0x{:x}", label, h),
            Self::AlignmentAnomaly { address } => write!(f, "{} ALIGN_FAIL: address=0x{:x}", label, address),
            Self::SecurityViolation { message, cvss } => write!(f, "{} SECURITY: {} (CVSS: {:.1})", label, message, cvss),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for KernelError {}

pub const ROOT_VMAR_HANDLE: u32 = 0;
pub const MAX_REGION_SIZE: usize = 1024 * 1024 * 1024;
pub const ZX_VM_PERM_READ: u32 = 1 << 1;
pub const ZX_VM_PERM_WRITE: u32 = 1 << 2;
pub const ZX_VM_MAP_RANGE: u32 = 1 << 4;

pub trait KernelOps: Send + Sync {
    fn vmo_clone(&self, parent: u32, size: usize) -> u32;
    fn vmar_map(&self, vmar: u32, options: u32, vmo: u32, size: usize) -> *mut u8;
    fn handle_close(&self, handle: u32);
}

pub struct HardwareInterface;

impl KernelOps for HardwareInterface {
    fn vmo_clone(&self, parent: u32, size: usize) -> u32 {
        println!(">> [MOCK KERNEL] Cloning VMO parent {} with size {}", parent, size);
        parent + 1 
    }
    fn vmar_map(&self, vmar: u32, _options: u32, vmo: u32, size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        println!(">> [MOCK KERNEL] Mapping VMO {} to VMAR {} (Size: {})", vmo, vmar, size);
        std::ptr::null_mut() // Safe null pointer for testing
    }
    fn handle_close(&self, handle: u32) {
        println!(">> [MOCK KERNEL] Closing handle {}", handle);
    }
}

pub mod raw {
    pub unsafe fn nexus_vmar_map(_vmar: u32, _options: u32, _vmo: u32, _size: usize) -> *mut u8 {
        std::ptr::null_mut()
    }
    pub unsafe fn nexus_vmo_clone(parent: u32, _size: usize) -> u32 {
        parent + 1
    }
    pub unsafe fn nexus_handle_close(_handle: u32) {}
}

pub struct VmarHandle(pub u32);

pub struct SafeBuffer {
    data: Vec<u8>,
    max_capacity: usize,
}

impl SafeBuffer {
    pub fn new(max_capacity: usize) -> Self {
        Self { data: Vec::with_capacity(max_capacity), max_capacity }
    }

    pub fn write_safe(&mut self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.data.len() + payload.len() > self.max_capacity {
            return Err("MEMORY FAULT: Buffer overflow prevented by strict bounds check.".into());
        }
        self.data.extend_from_slice(payload);
        Ok(())
    }
}

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;

pub const CACHE_LINE_SIZE: usize = 64;
pub const ALIGN_MASK: usize = CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1;

pub struct RealignmentEngine;

impl RealignmentEngine {
    /// check_alignment_fast: Deterministically verifies 64-byte boundaries.
    #[inline(always)]
    pub fn check_alignment_fast(address: *const u8) -> Result<(), KernelError> {
        let addr_val = address as usize;
        if (addr_val & ALIGN_MASK) == 0 {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(KernelError::AlignmentAnomaly { address: addr_val })
        }
    }
}

/// Standard alignment check to address CVSS 5.3 Alignment Anomaly
pub fn is_aligned(ptr: usize, align: usize) -> bool {
    if align == 0 || (align & (align - 1)) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ptr % align == 0
}

/// Secure wrapper for memory mapping offsets
pub fn validate_vmo_offset(offset: u64, size: u64, map_len: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
    if offset.checked_add(map_len).map_or(true, |end| end > size) {
        return Err("KERNEL_SECURITY: Out of bounds VMO mapping".to_string());
    }
    if !is_aligned(offset as usize, 4096) {
        return Err("KERNEL_SECURITY: Misaligned VMO mapping".to_string());
    }
    Ok(())
}

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;
use crate::kernel::ffi::{self, ZX_VM_PERM_READ, ZX_VM_PERM_WRITE, ZX_VM_MAP_RANGE};
use crate::kernel::vmo::Vmo;
use std::ptr;

/// VirtualMemoryAddressRegion: Orchestrates address space mapping.
pub struct Vmar;

impl Vmar {
    /// map: Maps a VMO into the specified VMAR handle using centralized permissions.
    pub fn map(vmar_handle: u32, vmo: &Vmo) -> Result<*mut u8, KernelError> {
        let options = ZX_VM_PERM_READ | ZX_VM_PERM_WRITE | ZX_VM_MAP_RANGE;
        
        let addr = unsafe {
            ffi::raw::nexus_vmar_map(vmar_handle, options, vmo.handle, vmo.size)
        };

        if addr == ptr::null_mut() {
            Err(KernelError::VmarMapFailed { 
                vmar_handle,
                size: vmo.size 
            })
        } else {
            Ok(addr)
        }
    }
}

[FILE: ./.lazarus_vault/1775579946/src/kernel/vmo.rs]

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;
use crate::kernel::ffi::KernelOps;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// Vmo: Virtual Memory Object owning a kernel handle.
pub struct Vmo {
    pub handle: u32,
    pub size: usize,
    ops: Arc<dyn KernelOps>,
}

impl Vmo {
    /// clone: Generates a child VMO using the provided hardware interface.
    pub fn clone(ops: Arc<dyn KernelOps>, parent: u32, size: usize) -> Result<Self, KernelError> {
        if parent == 0 { return Err(KernelError::InvalidHandle(0)); }
        
        let handle = ops.vmo_clone(parent, size);
        if handle == 0 {
            Err(KernelError::VmoCloneFailed { parent, size })
        } else {
            Ok(Self { handle, size, ops })
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for Vmo {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.ops.handle_close(self.handle);
    }
}

use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use chrono::Utc;
use sha2::{Sha256, Digest};
use anyhow::{Result, Context};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Snapshot {
    pub timestamp: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub author: String,
    pub hash: String,
    pub backup_path: String,
}

pub struct LazarusVault;

impl LazarusVault {
    const MAX_HISTORY: usize = 50;

    pub fn list_snapshots() -> Result<VecDeque<Snapshot>> {
        let ledger_path = Path::new(".lazarus/ledger.json");
        if !ledger_path.exists() { return Ok(VecDeque::new()); }
        let data = fs::read_to_string(ledger_path).context("Vault Read Fault")?;
        serde_json::from_str(&data).context("DNA Corruption")
    }

    pub fn auto_snapshot(target: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let content = fs::read_to_string(target).unwrap_or_default();
        Self::seal_patch(target, &content, reason)
    }

    pub fn seal_patch(target: &str, content: &str, reason: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let root = Path::new(".lazarus/snapshots");
        fs::create_dir_all(root)?;

        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
        hasher.update(content);
        let hash = hasher.finalize().iter().map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b)).collect::<String>();

        let timestamp = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
        let backup_path = root.join(format!("{}.snap", Utc::now().timestamp_micros()));
        fs::write(&backup_path, content)?;
        
        let mut ledger = Self::list_snapshots().unwrap_or_default();
        if ledger.len() >= Self::MAX_HISTORY { ledger.pop_front(); }

        ledger.push_back(Snapshot {
            timestamp,
            path: target.to_string(),
            author: format!("AUTO: {}", reason),
            hash: hash.clone(),
            backup_path: backup_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
        });
        
        fs::write(".lazarus/ledger.json", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&ledger)?)?;
        Ok(hash)
    }

    pub fn restore_snapshot(hash_prefix: &str) -> Result<String> {
        let ledger = Self::list_snapshots()?;
        let target_snap = ledger.iter().find(|s| s.hash.starts_with(hash_prefix))
            .context("!! [VAULT] Snapshot hash not found.")?;

        if !Path::new(&target_snap.backup_path).exists() {
            return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("!! [VAULT] Physical backup file missing."));
        }

        let safe_content = fs::read_to_string(&target_snap.backup_path)?;
        fs::write(&target_snap.path, safe_content)?;
        Ok(format!(">> [RESTORED] {} reverted to state {}", target_snap.path, hash_prefix))
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;

pub struct LocalLLM;

impl LocalLLM {
    pub fn new() -> Self { LocalLLM }

    /// Ephemeral Execution Protocol: Load -> Infer -> Drop RAM
    pub fn query_gemma_nano(&self, prompt: &str, model_path: &str) -> Result<String, NexusError> {
        println!("\x1b[35m>> [LOCAL_LLM] Allocating RAM for {}...\x1b[0m", model_path);
        
        // We use llama.cpp's CLI as a universal ARM64 execution wrapper.
        // We restrict context (-c 512) and output tokens (-n 128) to ensure 
        // the process completes in milliseconds and doesn't blow out the RAM.
        let output = Command::new("./vendor/llama.cpp/llama-cli")
            .args([
                "-m", model_path,
                "-p", prompt,
                "-n", "128", 
                "-c", "512",
                "--temp", "0.1",
                "--log-disable" // Ensure stdout only contains the AI's answer
            ])
            .output()
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("Failed to spawn local inference: {}", e)))?;

        if output.status.success() {
            let response = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string();
            println!("\x1b[35m>> [LOCAL_LLM] Inference complete. RAM flushed.\x1b[0m");
            Ok(response.trim().to_string())
        } else {
            let err = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
            Err(NexusError::Other(format!("Local GGUF Fault: {}", err)))
        }
    }
}

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32;
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, Mutex};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use nexus_singularity::{
    server, arbiter_agent, local_llm, neural_agent, system_monitor,
    orchestrator, memory, scheduler, task_manager, cli,
};
use std::io::{self, Write};

fn get_thermal_string() -> String {
    let temp = std::fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f32>().ok())
        .map(|t| t / 1000.0)
        .unwrap_or(0.0);

    let color = if temp > 75.0 { "\x1b[31m" } else if temp > 60.0 { "\x1b[33m" } else { "\x1b[32m" };
    format!("{}[{:.1}°C]\x1b[0m", color, temp)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    dotenvy::dotenv().ok();
    
    let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(512);
    let workspace_root = std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."));
    let api_key = std::env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY").expect("CRITICAL: GEMINI_API_KEY missing");
    
    let agent = Arc::new(neural_agent::MicroAgent::init(tx.clone())?);
    let monitor = system_monitor::SystemMonitor::new();
    let orchestrator = Arc::new(orchestrator::Orchestrator::new(agent.clone()));
    let memory_palace = memory::MemoryPalace::new(".nexus_memory.db").await?;
    let memory = Arc::new(Mutex::new(memory_palace));
    let arbiter = Arc::new(arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent::new(agent.clone(), Some(orchestrator.clone())));

    let scheduler_tx = scheduler::MasterSupervisor::ignite(
        tx.clone(), reqwest::Client::new(), api_key.clone(), orchestrator.clone(),
        Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0)), monitor.clone(), memory.clone()
    );

    let state = Arc::new(server::AppState {
        client: reqwest::Client::new(), monitor, agent: agent.clone(), orchestrator,
        memory: memory.clone(), api_key: api_key.clone(), current_resonance: Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0)),
        tx: tx.clone(), scheduler_tx, arbiter, local_llm: Arc::new(local_llm::LocalLLM::new()), workspace_root,
    });

    let server_state = state.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        server::start_server(server_state).await;
    });

    let muscle = cli::detect_host_muscle();
    println!("\n\x1b[1;36m╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\x1b[0m");
    println!("\x1b[1;36m║\x1b[0m  \x1b[1;37mNEXUS COMMAND INTERFACE ONLINE\x1b[0m \x1b[38;5;240m(v2.1.2-Zenith)\x1b[0m                             \x1b[1;36m║\x1b[0m");
    println!("\x1b[1;36m║\x1b[0m  \x1b[38;5;118mHOST SEATED:\x1b[0m {:<57} \x1b[1;36m║\x1b[0m", cli::get_muscle_string(&muscle));
    println!("\x1b[1;36m╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\x1b[0m\n");
    
    loop {
        let thermal = get_thermal_string();
        print!("\x1b[38;5;51m│\x1b[0m {} \x1b[38;5;51m❯\x1b[0m ", thermal);
        io::stdout().flush().unwrap();

        let mut input = String::new();
        if io::stdin().read_line(&mut input).is_err() { break; }
        let trimmed = input.trim();

        if trimmed == "exit" || trimmed == "quit" { break; }
        if trimmed.is_empty() { continue; }

        if trimmed.starts_with("task ") {
            let directive = trimmed.strip_prefix("task ").unwrap().trim().to_string();
            task_manager::send_task(
                agent.clone(), &reqwest::Client::new(), &api_key, &directive, memory.clone()
            ).await;
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions, SqlitePool, Row};
use std::path::Path;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentMemory {
    pub id: i64,
    pub origin: String,
    pub directive: String,
    pub result: String,
    pub timestamp: String,
}

pub struct MemoryPalace {
    pub pool: SqlitePool,
}

impl MemoryPalace {
    pub async fn new(db_path: &str) -> Result<Self, sqlx::Error> {
        if !Path::new(db_path).exists() {
            std::fs::File::create(db_path).ok();
        }
        let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(5)
            .connect(&format!("sqlite:{}", db_path))
            .await?;
        let palace = Self { pool };
        palace.init_full_schema().await?;
        Ok(palace)
    }

    pub async fn init_full_schema(&self) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS neural_context (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            origin TEXT NOT NULL,
            directive TEXT NOT NULL,
            result TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;

        sqlx::query("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memory_search USING fts5(
            directive, result, content='neural_context', content_rowid='id'
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;

        sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS healing_metrics (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            layer TEXT NOT NULL,
            success INTEGER NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            cvss REAL,
            notes TEXT
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn store_memory(&self, origin: &str, directive: &str, result: &str) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        let res = sqlx::query("INSERT INTO neural_context (origin, directive, result) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(origin).bind(directive).bind(result).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        let row_id = res.last_insert_rowid();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO memory_search (rowid, directive, result) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(row_id).bind(directive).bind(result).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn fetch_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50")
            .fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|row| AgentMemory {
            id: row.get("id"), origin: row.get("origin"), directive: row.get("directive"),
            result: row.get("result"), timestamp: row.get("timestamp"),
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn purge_all(&self) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM neural_context").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM memory_search").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn search_memories(&self, query: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context 
                                JOIN memory_search ON neural_context.id = memory_search.rowid 
                                WHERE memory_search MATCH ? ORDER BY rank LIMIT 5")
            .bind(query).fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|r| AgentMemory {
            id: r.get("id"), origin: r.get("origin"), directive: r.get("directive"),
            result: r.get("result"), timestamp: r.get("timestamp")
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn get_success_rate_for_layer(&self, layer: &str) -> f32 {
        let result = sqlx::query("SELECT CAST(SUM(success) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate FROM healing_metrics WHERE layer = ?")
            .bind(layer).fetch_optional(&self.pool).await;
        match result {
            Ok(Some(row)) => row.get::<Option<f32>, _>("rate").unwrap_or(0.78),
            _ => 0.78,
        }
    }
}

use prometheus::{Encoder, TextEncoder};

/// Ignite the baseline metrics registry
pub fn init_metrics() {
    // Placeholder for registering custom Prometheus counters/gauges later.
    // Currently a safe no-op to unblock the server route baseline.
}

/// Gathers all registered metrics and formats them for the /api/metrics route
pub fn get_metrics_text() -> String {
    let encoder = TextEncoder::new();
    let mut buffer = vec![];
    
    // Gather from the default global registry
    let metric_families = prometheus::gather();
    
    if let Err(e) = encoder.encode(&metric_families, &mut buffer) {
        eprintln!(">> [METRICS] Encoding failure: {}", e);
    }
    
    String::from_utf8_lossy(&buffer).to_string()
}

// NEXUS SINGULARITY — Mission Control v1.9.5
use crate::inquisitor::Inquisitor;
use crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent;
use crate::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent;
use crate::lazarus_vault::LazarusVault; // SUTURE: Restored
use crate::backend_autofix::fix_backend; // SUTURE: Restored
use crate::frontend_autofix::fix_ui; // SUTURE: Restored
use crate::server::AppState;
use std::sync::Arc;
use reqwest::Client;
use std::process::Command; // SUTURE: Restored

const CURRENT_VERSION: &str = "v1.9.5";

pub async fn run_repair_sequence(agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, api_key: &str, target: &str) {
    let client = Client::new();
    println!("\x1b[35m>> [MISSION CONTROL] Diagnosis: {}\x1b[0m", target);

    for _attempt in 1..=3 {
        let error_log = if target == "ui" {
            Inquisitor::audit_ui().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.to_string())
        } else {
            Inquisitor::audit_backend().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.to_string())
        };

        if error_log == "NOMINAL" {
            println!("\x1b[32m>> [STABLE] {} nominal\x1b[0m", target);
            return;
        }

        let prompt = format!("CRITICAL ERROR:\n{}\n\nRETURN JSON ONLY: {{\"file\": \"path\", \"fix\": \"code\"}}", error_log);
        
        if let Ok((response, _)) = agent.prepare_and_run(&client, api_key, &prompt, Default::default(), 0.2).await {
            let start = response.find('{');
            let end = response.rfind('}');
            
            if let (Some(s), Some(e)) = (start, end) {
                let clean_json = &response[s..=e];
                if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(clean_json) {
                    let file_path = json["file"].as_str().unwrap_or_default();
                    let fix_code = json["fix"].as_str().unwrap_or_default();

                    if !file_path.is_empty() && !fix_code.is_empty() {
                        let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(agent.clone(), None);
                        if let Ok(report) = arbiter.analyze_directive(api_key, &format!("Audit patch for {}: {}", file_path, fix_code)).await {
                            if report.can_proceed && report.risk_score < 0.45 {
                                let _ = std::fs::write(file_path, fix_code);
                                println!("\x1b[32m>> [SURGERY] Patch applied to {}\x1b[0m", file_path);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    println!("\x1b[36m>> [UPGRADE] v{}\x1b[0m", CURRENT_VERSION);
    let _ = LazarusVault::auto_snapshot("src/main.rs", "pre-upgrade");

    let ui_ok = Command::new("npm").current_dir("ui").args(["run", "build"]).status().map(|s| s.success()).unwrap_or(false);

}

use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::server::AppState;
use crate::component_runner::{AgentHandle, Capabilities};
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum StepStatus {
    Pending, Running, Done, Failed(String),
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MissionStep {
    pub id: usize,
    pub description: String,
    pub action: Option<AgentAction>,
    pub status: StepStatus,
    pub result: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Mission {
    pub id: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub steps: Vec<MissionStep>,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub completed: bool,
}

pub struct MissionPlanner;

impl MissionPlanner {
    pub async fn execute(state: &Arc<AppState>, mut mission: Mission) -> anyhow::Result<Mission> {
        let (lifecycle_tx, _) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel(16);

        // Spawn supervised actor handle for the entire mission
        let handle: AgentHandle = crate::component_runner::AgentComponent::spawn(
            &format!("mission-{}", mission.id),
            Capabilities::READ_FS | Capabilities::WRITE_FS,
            state.agent.clone(),
            lifecycle_tx,
        );

        for step in mission.steps.iter_mut() {
            if step.status != StepStatus::Pending { continue; }
            step.status = StepStatus::Running;

            if let Some(action) = step.action.clone() {
                match handle.execute_actions(vec![action]).await {
                    Ok(results) => {
                        step.status = StepStatus::Done;
                        step.result = Some(results.join("\n"));
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        step.status = StepStatus::Failed(e.to_string());
                        // Log to lifecycle for supervision
                        let _ = state.tx.send(format!("Mission step {} failed: {}", step.id, e));
                        break; // Stop on first failure (fail-fast)
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mission.completed = mission.steps.iter().all(|s| matches!(s.status, StepStatus::Done));
        Ok(mission)
    }
}

use anyhow::Result;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions, SqlitePool, Row};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PersistentMission {
    pub id: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub status: String,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub payload: String,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct MissionQueue {
    pool: SqlitePool,
}

impl MissionQueue {
    pub async fn new(db_path: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(5)
            .connect(&format!("sqlite:{}", db_path))
            .await?;

        let queue = Self { pool };
        queue.init_schema().await?;
        Ok(queue)
    }

    async fn init_schema(&self) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS missions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                goal TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                payload TEXT NOT NULL
            )"
        )
        .execute(&self.pool)
        .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn enqueue(&self, mission: PersistentMission) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO missions (id, goal, status, created_at, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(&mission.id)
            .bind(&mission.goal)
            .bind(&mission.status)
            .bind(mission.created_at)
            .bind(&mission.payload)
            .execute(&self.pool)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_pending(&self) -> Result<Vec<PersistentMission>> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, goal, status, created_at, payload FROM missions WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at")
            .fetch_all(&self.pool)
            .await?;

        let mut results = Vec::new();
        for row in rows {
            results.push(PersistentMission {
                id: row.get("id"),
                goal: row.get("goal"),
                status: row.get("status"),
                created_at: row.get("created_at"),
                payload: row.get("payload"),
            });
        }
        Ok(results)
    }

    pub async fn update_status(&self, id: &str, status: &str) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query("UPDATE missions SET status = ? WHERE id = ?")
            .bind(status)
            .bind(id)
            .execute(&self.pool)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct GemmaRequest {
    pub contents: Vec<Content>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct Content {
    pub role: String,
    pub parts: Vec<Part>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
#[serde(untagged)]
pub enum Part {
    Text { text: String },
    InlineData { inline_data: InlineData },
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct InlineData {
    pub mime_type: String,
    pub data: String, // Base64 encoded string
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct GemmaResponse {
    pub candidates: Vec<Candidate>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct Candidate {
    pub content: ContentResponse,
    pub finish_reason: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ContentResponse {
    pub parts: Vec<TextPart>,
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct TextPart {
    pub text: String,
}

use std::fs::File;
use std::io::Read;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct NanoAgent {
    pub load: Arc<AtomicU32>,
}

impl NanoAgent {
    pub fn inject() -> Self {
        let load = Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0));
        let l_clone = load.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (mut p_idle, mut p_total) = (0, 0);
            let mut buf = [0u8; 512];
            loop {
                if let Ok(mut f) = File::open("/proc/stat") {
                    let n = f.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0);
                    let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]);
                    if let Some(line) = s.lines().next() {
                        let v: Vec<u64> = line.split_whitespace().filter_map(|s| s.parse().ok()).collect();
                        if v.len() >= 4 {
                            let total: u64 = v.iter().sum();
                            let idle = v[3];
                            let (td, id) = (total - p_total, idle - p_idle);
                            if td > 0 {
                                let usage = ((td - id) as f32 / td as f32) * 100.0;
                                l_clone.store(usage.to_bits(), Ordering::Relaxed);
                            }
                            p_total = total; p_idle = idle;
                        }
                    }
                }
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(1000));
            }
        });
        Self { load }
    }

    pub async fn run_cycle(&self) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let usage = f32::from_bits(self.load.load(Ordering::Relaxed));
        Ok(format!("Telemetry Pulse: CPU at {:.2}%", usage))
    }
}

impl Default for NanoAgent {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::inject()
    }
}

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use crate::resonator::resonator_ignite;
use crate::kernel::realignment::ALIGN_MASK;

pub struct NativeAgent {
    pub id: String,
    pub mission_profile: String,
    pub is_active: bool,
    pub hardware_affinity: String,
}

pub struct NativeAgentManager {
    pub agents: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, NativeAgent>>>,
}

impl NativeAgentManager {
    pub fn init() -> Self {
        let mut agents = HashMap::new();
        // Initialize the 68 core agents
        for i in 0..68 {
            let id = format!("agent_{}", i);
            agents.insert(id.clone(), NativeAgent {
                id: id.clone(),
                mission_profile: format!("nexus_task_profile_{}", id),
                is_active: false,
                hardware_affinity: "CPU".to_string(),
            });
        }
        Self { agents: Arc::new(Mutex::new(agents)) }
    }

    /// 0.90 Handshake: Verifies hardware signature of the ARM64 NPU
    async fn verify_npu_signature(&self) -> Result<bool> {
        // Simulated hardware register check
        Ok(true) 
    }

    pub async fn ignite_agent(&self, agent_id: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let mut agents = self.agents.lock().await;
        let agent = agents.get_mut(agent_id).ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("Agent not found"))?;

        // Phase 1: NPU Negotiation
        if self.verify_npu_signature().await.unwrap_or(false) {
            let ptr = agent.mission_profile.as_ptr() as usize;
            
            // Phase 2: Enforce 64-byte ALIGN_MASK (Zero-copy safety)
            if (ptr & ALIGN_MASK) == 0 {
                agent.hardware_affinity = "NPU".to_string();
                eprintln!(">> [NPU_UPLINK] Agent {} bound to NPU (Aligned)", agent_id);
            } else {
                agent.hardware_affinity = "CPU_ATOMIC".to_string();
                eprintln!(">> [ALIGN_FAULT] Realignment required. Falling back to CPU.");
            }
        }

        // Phase 3: FFI Ignition via Zig Resonator
        let profile = &agent.mission_profile;
        if unsafe { resonator_ignite(profile.as_ptr(), profile.len()) } {
            agent.is_active = true;
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(anyhow!("Ignition sequence failed"))
        }
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

/// start_duet_listener: Polls for remote git commands on a 60-second cycle.
///
/// FIX: The previous implementation used std::thread::sleep inside a blocking
/// loop. If this function was ever spawned on a Tokio worker thread (via
/// tokio::spawn), it would park the thread for 60 seconds per iteration,
/// starving other tasks on the same thread. This is now an async fn using
/// tokio::time::sleep, which yields the thread back to the runtime while waiting.
///
/// Callers should use: tokio::spawn(network::start_duet_listener());
pub async fn start_duet_listener() {
    println!(">> [SOVEREIGN] DUET LISTENER ACTIVE.");
    loop {
        // Non-blocking git fetch check for external command dispatch
        let _ = Command::new("git").args(["fetch", "origin"]).output();
        // Yields the Tokio thread back to the runtime during the wait
        sleep(Duration::from_secs(60)).await;
    }
}

use crate::nexus_error::NexusError;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use reqwest::Client;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use futures_util::StreamExt;
use std::io::{self, Write};

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Default)]
pub struct ContextPacket {
    pub current_file: String,
    pub recent_logs: Vec<String>,
    pub file_content: Option<String>,
    pub terminal_log: Option<String>,
    pub system_prompt: Option<String>,
    pub target_model: Option<String>,
}

pub struct MicroAgent {
    pub memory: Mutex<VecDeque<Value>>,
    pub tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
}

impl MicroAgent {
    pub fn init(tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Result<Self, NexusError> {
        Ok(MicroAgent { memory: Mutex::new(VecDeque::with_capacity(16)), tx })
    }

    pub async fn prepare_and_run(
        &self,
        client: &Client,
        api_key: &str,
        user_text: &str,
        ctx: ContextPacket,
        _resonance: f32,
    ) -> Result<(String, u128), NexusError> {
        let start_time = std::time::Instant::now();
        
        // CORRECT MODEL IDENTITY: Gemma-4 26B MoE
        let model = "gemma-4-31b-it";
        
        let url = format!(
            "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&key={}", 
            model, api_key
        );

        let sys_prompt = ctx.system_prompt.unwrap_or_else(|| "You are NEXUS Ghost, a Sovereign AI Architect.".to_string());

        // PROTOCOL ALIGNMENT: system_instruction used for higher instruction adherence in Gemma-4
        let payload = json!({ 
            "system_instruction": {
                "parts": [{ "text": sys_prompt }]
            },
            "contents": [
                { "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": user_text }] }
            ],
            "generationConfig": { 
                "temperature": 0.2, 
                "maxOutputTokens": 8192,
                "topP": 0.95,
                "topK": 64
            }
        });

        let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_start"}).to_string());

        let response = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await
            .map_err(|e| NexusError::Other(format!("UPLINK_FAIL: {}", e)))?;

        if !response.status().is_success() {
            let status = response.status();
            let err_text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_end"}).to_string());
            let formatted_err = format!("API_HTTP_{}: {}", status, err_text);
            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "error", "payload": &formatted_err}).to_string());
            return Err(NexusError::Other(formatted_err));
        }

        let mut full_text = String::new();
        let mut line_buffer = String::new();
        let mut stream = response.bytes_stream();

        print!("\n\x1b[38;5;51m[NEXUS_STREAM] \x1b[0m");

        while let Some(item) = stream.next().await {
            if let Ok(bytes) = item {
                line_buffer.push_str(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes).replace("\r\n", "\n"));
                while let Some(newline_pos) = line_buffer.find("\n\n") {
                    let chunk = line_buffer[..newline_pos].to_string();
                    line_buffer.drain(..newline_pos + 2);
                    let clean = chunk.trim_start_matches("data: ").trim();
                    if clean.is_empty() || clean == "[DONE]" { continue; }
                    
                    if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(clean) {
                        if let Some(token) = val["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
                            print!("\x1b[38;5;253m{}\x1b[0m", token);
                            io::stdout().flush().ok();
                            let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_token", "payload": token}).to_string());
                            full_text.push_str(token);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        let leftover = line_buffer.trim_start_matches("data: ").trim();
        if !leftover.is_empty() && leftover != "[DONE]" && leftover != "[" && leftover != "]" {
            if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(leftover) {
                if let Some(token) = val["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
                    print!("\x1b[38;5;253m{}\x1b[0m", token);
                    io::stdout().flush().ok();
                    let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_token", "payload": token}).to_string());
                    full_text.push_str(token);
                }
            }
        }

        println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244m--------------------------------\x1b[0m\n");
        let _ = self.tx.send(json!({"type": "ghost_end"}).to_string());
        Ok((full_text, start_time.elapsed().as_millis()))
    }
}

use std::fmt;
use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum NexusError {
    NotFound(String),
    Patch(String),
    KernelFault(KernelError),
    NeuralLinkSevered(String),
    Other(String),
    SecurityViolation { message: String, cvss: f32 },
}

impl fmt::Display for NexusError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
        match self {
            Self::SecurityViolation { message, cvss } => write!(f, "!! [SECURITY] CVSS {:.1}: {}", cvss, message),
            Self::KernelFault(e) => write!(f, "!! [KERNEL_DNA_FAULT] {}", e),
            Self::NotFound(e) => write!(f, ">> [FS_FAULT] Not Found: {}", e),
            Self::Patch(e) => write!(f, ">> [DIFF_FAULT] Patch Failed: {}", e),
            Self::NeuralLinkSevered(e) => write!(f, "!! [UPLINK_FAULT]: {}", e),
            Self::Other(e) => write!(f, ">> [SYSTEM_FAULT]: {}", e),
        }
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for NexusError {}

impl From<std::io::Error> for NexusError {
    fn from(err: std::io::Error) -> Self {
        NexusError::Other(format!("IO_FAULT: {}", err))
    }
}

impl From<KernelError> for NexusError {
    fn from(err: KernelError) -> Self {
        NexusError::KernelFault(err)
    }
}

use crate::neural_agent::{MicroAgent, ContextPacket};
use crate::component_runner::AgentHandle;
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent;
use anyhow::Result;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct Orchestrator {
    pub agent: Arc<MicroAgent>,
    handle: AgentHandle,
}

impl Orchestrator {
    pub fn new(agent: Arc<MicroAgent>) -> Self {
        let (tx, _) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel(16);
        let handle = crate::component_runner::AgentComponent::spawn(
            "orchestrator",
            crate::component_runner::Capabilities::READ_FS | crate::component_runner::Capabilities::WRITE_FS,
            agent.clone(),
            tx,
        );

        Self { agent, handle }
    }

    pub async fn run_autonomous_loop(
        &self,
        instruction: String,
        context: ContextPacket,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        api_key: &str,
        _tx: &tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>,
        _monitor: &crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor,
    ) -> Result<String> {
        let (raw_response, _) = self.agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &instruction, context, 1.0)
            .await
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e.to_string()))?;

        match AgentAction::extract_and_parse(&raw_response) {
            Ok(actions) => {
                // UPGRADE: Consult the Arbiter before executing the loop
                let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(self.agent.clone(), None);
                let action_json = serde_json::to_string(&actions).unwrap_or_default();
                
                if let Ok(report) = arbiter.analyze_directive(api_key, &action_json).await {
                    if !report.can_proceed || report.risk_score >= 0.45 {
                        return Ok(format!("!! [ARBITER BLOCK] Risk Score: {:.2}. Reason: {}", report.risk_score, report.recommendation));
                    }
                }

                let results: Vec<String> = self.handle.execute_actions(actions).await
                    .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e.to_string()))?;
                Ok(results.join("\n"))
            }
            Err(e) => {
                println!(">> [ORCHESTRATOR] Protocol extraction failed: {}. Returning raw response.", e);
                Ok(raw_response)
            }
        }
    }
}

use tokio::process::Command;
use std::process::Stdio;
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, BufReader};
use anyhow::Result;

pub struct PodmanShield;

impl PodmanShield {
    /// execute_isolated: Asynchronous Zircon-style IPC stream
    pub async fn execute_isolated(directive: &str, workspace_path: &str) -> Result<String> {
        println!(">> [SHIELD] Opening Async IPC Channel to Bio-Dome...");

        let mut child = Command::new("podman")
            .args([
                "run",
                "--rm",
                "--network", "none",            // Air-gapped
                "--memory", "512m",             // Resource governed
                "-v", &format!("{}:/workspace:z", workspace_path), // 'z' for Crostini/Termux safety
                "-w", "/workspace",
                "docker.io/library/rust:alpine",
                "sh", "-c", directive
            ])
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()?;

        let stdout = child.stdout.take().expect("Failed to capture Bio-Dome stdout");
        let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdout).lines();
        let mut output_buffer = String::new();

        // Real-time telemetry feed
        while let Ok(Some(line)) = reader.next_line().await {
            // Echoing the stream live to the host terminal
            println!(">> [BIO-DOME TELEMETRY]: {}", line);
            
            // Zircon-style Signal Check: The Arbiter's kill switch
            if line.contains("MALICIOUS_INTENT") {
                println!("!! [ARBITER] Rogue behavior detected. Severing IPC.");
                let _ = child.kill().await;
                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("SHIELD_BREACH: Malicious intent intercepted."));
            }
            
            output_buffer.push_str(&line);
            output_buffer.push('\n');
        }

        let status = child.wait().await?;
        if status.success() {
            println!(">> [SHIELD] Bio-Dome process completed successfully.");
            Ok(output_buffer)
        } else {
            Err(anyhow::anyhow!("SHIELD_FAULT: Bio-Dome exited with {}", status))
        }
    }
}

use std::path::Path;
use std::process::Command;
use serde::Serialize;
use walkdir::WalkDir;

#[derive(Serialize)]
pub struct BuildResult {
    pub success: bool,
    pub log: String,
    pub detected_stack: String,
}

pub fn detect_and_build(path: &str) -> BuildResult {
    let p = Path::new(path);

    let (cmd, args, stack) = if p.join("Cargo.toml").exists() {
        ("cargo", vec!["build", "--release"], "RUST")
    } else if p.join("package.json").exists() {
        ("npm", vec!["run", "build"], "NODEJS")
    } else if p.join("requirements.txt").exists() {
        ("pip", vec!["install", "-r", "requirements.txt"], "PYTHON")
    } else if p.join("Makefile").exists() {
        ("make", vec![], "MAKEFILE")
    } else {
        return BuildResult {
            success: false,
            log: ">> UNKNOWN STACK".to_string(),
            detected_stack: "UNKNOWN".into(),
        };
    };

    println!(">> [POLYGLOT] Building {} project at {}...", stack, path);
    let output = Command::new(cmd).args(&args).current_dir(path).output();

    match output {
        Ok(out) => {
            let log = format!(
                "STDOUT:\n{}\nSTDERR:\n{}",
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout),
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)
            );
            BuildResult {
                success: out.status.success(),
                log,
                detected_stack: stack.into(),
            }
        }
        Err(e) => BuildResult {
            success: false,
            log: e.to_string(),
            detected_stack: stack.into(),
        },
    }
}

pub fn generate_project_tree() -> String {
    let mut tree = String::from("PROJECT STRUCTURE:\n");
    for entry in WalkDir::new(".")
        .max_depth(2)
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
    {
        let path = entry.path();
        let display = path.display().to_string();

        if display.contains("/target")
            || display.contains("/.git")
            || display.contains("/node_modules")
            || display.contains("/dist")
        {
            continue;
        }

        let depth = display.matches('/').count();
        let indent = "  ".repeat(depth);
        tree.push_str(&format!(
            "{}{}\n",
            indent,
            path.file_name().unwrap_or_default().to_string_lossy()
        ));
    }
    tree
}

const std = @import("std");

/// Pulls live thermal data from the kernel (ARM64 safe)
export fn get_thermal_temp() callconv(.C) f32 {
    const path = "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp";
    var file = std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{}) catch return 0.0;
    defer file.close();

    var buf: [16]u8 = undefined;
    const amt = file.readAll(&buf) catch return 0.0;
    if (amt == 0) return 0.0;
    
    const temp_str = std.mem.trim(u8, buf[0..amt], " \n\t\r");
    const temp_raw = std.fmt.parseFloat(f32, temp_str) catch return 0.0;
    
    return temp_raw / 1000.0;
}

/// Hardware bind success stub (always returns true for current ARM64 stability)
export fn resonator_ignite(path_ptr: [*]const u8, path_len: usize) callconv(.C) bool {
    _ = path_ptr;
    _ = path_len;
    return true; 
}

export fn scan_entropy() callconv(.C) f32 {
    return 0.95; // High entropy baseline for NEXUS resonance
}

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use std::env;

/// Validates that a requested path strictly resides within the Nexus workspace.
/// Neutralizes directory traversal attacks (e.g., "../../../etc/shadow").
pub fn validate_path(requested_path: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let workspace_root = env::current_dir()?;
    let target_path = Path::new(requested_path);
    
    // Resolve to an absolute path first
    let absolute_target = if target_path.is_absolute() {
        target_path.to_path_buf()
    } else {
        workspace_root.join(target_path)
    };

    // To prevent symlink escapes and normalize ".." traversals, we must canonicalize.
    // Canonicalization requires the path to exist. If creating a new file, we check the parent.
    let mut check_path = absolute_target.clone();
    if !check_path.exists() {
        if let Some(parent) = check_path.parent() {
            check_path = parent.to_path_buf();
        } else {
            return Err(anyhow!("Invalid path structure requested."));
        }
    }

    // Resolve the actual physical paths on the ARM64 disk
    let canonical_target = check_path.canonicalize()
        .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Sandbox resolution failed: {}", e))?;
    let canonical_root = workspace_root.canonicalize()
        .map_err(|e| anyhow!("Workspace root resolution failed: {}", e))?;

    // The core security check: Does the target physically reside inside the root?
    if canonical_target.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
        Ok(absolute_target)
    } else {
        Err(anyhow!(
            "[SECURITY VIOLATION] Agent attempted directory traversal outside workspace bounds: {}", 
            requested_path
        ))
    }
}

use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{mpsc, oneshot, broadcast, Mutex};
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};
use crate::neural_agent::ContextPacket;
use crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator;
use crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor;
use crate::mission_queue::MissionQueue;
use crate::thermal_governor::ThermalGovernor;
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum Domain { UI, Code, Build, Security }

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub enum TaskPriority { Low, Normal, High, Critical }

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NexusTask {
    pub priority: TaskPriority, // SUTURE: Moved to first position for correct sorting
    pub id: String,
    pub domain: Domain,
    pub payload: String,
    pub context: ContextPacket,
    pub response_tx: Option<oneshot::Sender<String>>,
}

// Manual Ord implementation to ensure Priority takes precedence over ID
impl Ord for NexusTask {
    fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> std::cmp::Ordering {
        self.priority.cmp(&other.priority).then_with(|| self.id.cmp(&other.id))
    }
}

impl PartialOrd for NexusTask {
    fn partial_cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Option<std::cmp::Ordering> { Some(self.cmp(other)) }
}

impl PartialEq for NexusTask {
    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool { self.priority == other.priority && self.id == other.id }
}

impl Eq for NexusTask {}

pub struct MasterSupervisor;

impl MasterSupervisor {
    pub fn ignite(
        b_tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
        client: reqwest::Client,
        api_key: String,
        orchestrator: Arc<Orchestrator>,
        _resonance: Arc<AtomicU32>,
        _monitor: SystemMonitor,
        memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>,
    ) -> mpsc::Sender<NexusTask> {
        let (global_tx, mut global_rx) = mpsc::channel::<NexusTask>(128);

        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let queue = match MissionQueue::new(".nexus_missions.db").await {
                Ok(q) => q,
                Err(e) => {
                    let _ = b_tx.send(format!("!! [QUEUE FAULT] {}", e));
                    return;
                }
            };

            let governor = ThermalGovernor::new();
            let mut heap: std::collections::BinaryHeap<NexusTask> = std::collections::BinaryHeap::new();

            loop {
                while let Ok(task) = global_rx.try_recv() {
                    heap.push(task);
                }

                governor.apply_cooldown().await;

                if let Some(task) = heap.pop() {
                    let orch = orchestrator.clone();
                    let cl = client.clone();
                    let ak = api_key.clone();
                    let q = queue.clone();
                    let mem = memory.clone();
                    let task_id = task.id.clone();
                    let b_tx_clone = b_tx.clone();

                    tokio::spawn(async move {
                        let _ = q.update_status(&task_id, "running").await;
                        let _ = b_tx_clone.send(format!("\x1b[35m>> [DRONE ACTIVE] Executing Task: {}\x1b[0m", task_id));

                        let result = crate::task_manager::send_task(
                            orch.agent.clone(), &cl, &ak, &task.payload, mem
                        ).await;
                        
                        let _ = q.update_status(&task_id, "done").await;
                        let _ = b_tx_clone.send(format!("\x1b[35m>> [DRONE COMPLETE] Task: {}\x1b[0m", task_id));

                        if let Some(tx) = task.response_tx { let _ = tx.send(result); }
                    });
                }
                sleep(Duration::from_millis(250)).await;
            }
        });

        global_tx
    }
}

use crate::{
    inquisitor::Inquisitor,
    arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent,
    thermal_governor::ThermalGovernor,
    mission_planner::{Mission, MissionStep, StepStatus},
    memory::MemoryPalace,
    server::AppState,
};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};
use chrono::Utc;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum HealingLayer {
    Kernel, Backend, Frontend, Swarm,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct HealingIssue {
    pub layer: HealingLayer,
    pub description: String,
    pub cvss: f32,
}

pub struct SelfHealingEngine {
    state: Arc<AppState>,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>,
    governor: ThermalGovernor,
}

impl SelfHealingEngine {
    pub fn new(state: Arc<AppState>, memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>) -> Self {
        Self {
            state,
            memory,
            governor: ThermalGovernor::new(),
        }
    }

    pub async fn ignite_autonomic_loop(self) {
        println!("\x1b[36m>> [SELF-HEALING v2.0] Autonomic Loop Started (4GB safe)\x1b[0m");

        loop {
            self.governor.apply_cooldown().await;

            let vitals = self.state.monitor.get_vitals();

            // Strong resource guard for Lenovo Duet 4GB
            if vitals.cpu_load > 0.65 || vitals.temperature > 68.0 || vitals.ram_gb > 3.2 {
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(90)).await;
                continue;
            }

            let issues = self.diagnose().await;
            for issue in issues {
                let priority = self.calculate_priority(&issue, &vitals).await;
                if priority > 0.52 {
                    let mission = self.create_mission(&issue).await;
                    let _ = crate::mission_planner::MissionPlanner::execute(&self.state, mission).await;
                }
            }

            self.record_cycle().await;
            sleep(Duration::from_secs(75)).await;
        }
    }

    async fn diagnose(&self) -> Vec<HealingIssue> {
        let mut issues = Vec::new();

        if let Ok(log) = Inquisitor::audit_backend() {
            if log != "NOMINAL" {
                issues.push(HealingIssue { layer: HealingLayer::Backend, description: log, cvss: 7.5 });
            }
        }
        if let Ok(log) = Inquisitor::audit_ui() {
            if log != "NOMINAL" {
                issues.push(HealingIssue { layer: HealingLayer::Frontend, description: log, cvss: 6.8 });
            }
        }
        issues
    }

    async fn calculate_priority(&self, issue: &HealingIssue, vitals: &crate::system_monitor::Vitals) -> f32 {
        let base = issue.cvss / 10.0;
        let thermal_factor = if vitals.temperature > 65.0 { 0.6 } else { 1.0 };
        base * thermal_factor * 0.78   // simple historical factor
    }

    async fn create_mission(&self, issue: &HealingIssue) -> Mission {
        let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(self.state.agent.clone(), Some(self.state.orchestrator.clone()));
        let _ = arbiter.analyze_directive(&self.state.api_key, &issue.description).await;

        Mission {
            id: format!("heal-{}", Utc::now().timestamp()),
            goal: format!("Repair {:?}", issue.layer),
            steps: vec![
                MissionStep { id: 1, description: "Lazarus pre-snapshot".into(), action: None, status: StepStatus::Pending, result: None },
                MissionStep { id: 2, description: format!("Fix {:?}", issue.layer), action: None, status: StepStatus::Pending, result: None },
                MissionStep { id: 3, description: "Validate repair".into(), action: None, status: StepStatus::Pending, result: None },
            ],
            created_at: Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            completed: false,
        }
    }

    async fn record_cycle(&self) {
        let palace = self.memory.lock().await;
        let _ = palace.store_memory(
            "SelfHealingEngine",
            "autonomic_cycle",
            "Completed diagnostic + repair pass with learning feedback",
        ).await;
    }
}

use std::fs;

pub fn is_fit_for_work() -> bool {
    // Check Load Average to prevent overheating on the Duet
    if let Ok(load_str) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/loadavg") {
        let load: f32 = load_str.split_whitespace()
            .next()
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        // Throttle if load > 4.0 (Quad Core saturation)
        if load > 4.0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    true
}

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};
use axum::http::StatusCode;
use tokio_util::io::ReaderStream;

pub async fn handle_factory_export() -> impl IntoResponse {
    let folder = ".lazarus/factory";
    let output_zip = "nexus_factory_export.zip";

    let _ = std::process::Command::new("zip")
        .args(["-r", "-j", output_zip, folder])
        .status();

    let file = match tokio::fs::File::open(output_zip).await {
        Ok(f) => f,
        Err(_) => return (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Export Failed").into_response(),
    };

    let stream = ReaderStream::new(file);
    let body = axum::body::Body::from_stream(stream);

    Response::builder()
        .header("Content-Type", "application/zip")
        .header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=\"nexus_swarm_factory.zip\"")
        .body(body)
        .unwrap()
}

use axum::{
    extract::{Query, State, ws::{WebSocketUpgrade, WebSocket, Message}},
    http::{header, StatusCode, Uri},
    response::IntoResponse,
    routing::{get, post, delete},
    Json, Router,
};
use rust_embed::RustEmbed;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::json;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tower_http::cors::CorsLayer;
use crate::{task_manager, sandbox};

#[derive(RustEmbed)]
#[folder = "ui/dist/"]
struct Assets;

pub struct AppState {
    pub client: reqwest::Client,
    pub monitor: crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor,
    pub agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
    pub orchestrator: Arc<crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator>,
    pub memory: Arc<tokio::sync::Mutex<crate::memory::MemoryPalace>>,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub current_resonance: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32>,
    pub tx: tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>,
    pub scheduler_tx: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<crate::scheduler::NexusTask>,
    pub arbiter: Arc<crate::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent>,
    pub local_llm: Arc<crate::local_llm::LocalLLM>,
    pub workspace_root: std::path::PathBuf,
}

pub async fn start_server(state: Arc<AppState>) {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/api/fs/list", get(handle_fs_list))
        .route("/api/fs/read", get(handle_read_file))
        .route("/api/fs/write", post(handle_write_file))
        .route("/api/fs/delete", delete(handle_delete_file))
        .route("/api/memories", get(handle_get_memories))
        .route("/api/memories/search", get(handle_search_memories))
        .route("/api/memories/purge", delete(handle_purge_memories))
        .route("/api/missions", get(handle_get_missions))
        .route("/api/lazarus/snapshots", get(handle_lazarus_snapshots))
        .route("/api/task", post(handle_task))
        .route("/ws/nexus", get(ws_handler))
        .fallback(static_handler)
        .with_state(state)
        .layer(CorsLayer::permissive());

    let addr = "0.0.0.0:3000";
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind(&addr).await.unwrap();
    println!("\x1b[38;2;0;255;255m>> [NEXUS SERVER] UNIFIED UPLINK: http://localhost:3000\x1b[0m");
    axum::serve(listener, app.into_make_service()).await.unwrap();
}

async fn handle_fs_list(Query(p): Query<ListParams>, State(_state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let path = p.path.as_deref().unwrap_or(".");
    match sandbox::validate_path(path) {
        Ok(safe) => {
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(&safe) {
                for entry in rd.flatten() {
                    let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                    if !name.starts_with('.') && name != "target" && name != "node_modules" {
                        entries.push(FsEntry {
                            name,
                            path: entry.path().to_string_lossy().to_string(),
                            is_dir: entry.path().is_dir(),
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            (StatusCode::OK, Json(entries)).into_response()
        }
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_get_memories(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await;
    match palace.fetch_all().await {
        Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Memory Read Fault: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_search_memories(Query(q): Query<SearchQuery>, State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let query = q.q.as_deref().unwrap_or("");
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await;
    match palace.search_memories(query).await {
        Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Search Fault: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_purge_memories(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await;
    match palace.purge_all().await {
        Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK.into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Purge Fault: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_get_missions() -> impl IntoResponse {
    match crate::mission_queue::MissionQueue::new(".nexus_missions.db").await {
        Ok(queue) => match queue.get_pending().await {
            Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(),
            Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Queue Error: {}", e)).into_response(),
        },
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Init Error: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_lazarus_snapshots() -> impl IntoResponse {
    match crate::lazarus_vault::LazarusVault::list_snapshots() {
        Ok(snaps) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(snaps)).into_response(),
        Err(e) => (StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, format!("Vault Error: {}", e)).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_task(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>, Json(payload): Json<TaskRequest>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let agent = state.agent.clone();
    let client = state.client.clone();
    let api_key = state.api_key.clone();
    let memory = state.memory.clone();
    let directive = payload.directive.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        let _ = task_manager::send_task(agent, &client, &api_key, &directive, memory).await;
    });
    Json(json!({ "status": "QUEUED" }))
}

async fn ws_handler(ws: WebSocketUpgrade, State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    ws.on_upgrade(|socket| handle_socket(socket, state))
}

async fn handle_socket(mut socket: WebSocket, state: Arc<AppState>) {
    let mut rx = state.tx.subscribe();
    let mut heartbeat = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(3));
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            Ok(msg) = rx.recv() => {
                if socket.send(Message::Text(msg)).await.is_err() { break; }
            }
            _ = heartbeat.tick() => {
                let v = state.monitor.get_vitals();
                let payload = json!({ "type": "telemetry", "payload": v });
                if socket.send(Message::Text(payload.to_string())).await.is_err() { break; }
            }
            Some(Ok(msg)) = socket.recv() => {
                if let Message::Text(text) = msg {
                    if let Ok(parsed) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&text) {
                        if parsed["type"] == "directive" {
                            let mut cmd = parsed["payload"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string();
                            
                            // === SUTURE: AUTONOMIC CONTEXT INJECTOR ===
                            let lower_cmd = cmd.to_lowercase();
                            if lower_cmd.contains("audit") || lower_cmd.contains("all the code") {
                                let _ = state.tx.send(String::from(">> [CORTEX_UPLINK] Broad audit detected. Injecting local workspace DNA..."));
                                let mut context = String::from("\n\n--- [SYSTEM WORKSPACE DNA] ---\n");
                                
                                if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir("src") {
                                    for entry in entries.flatten() {
                                        let path = entry.path();
                                        if path.is_file() && path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                                            if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                                                // Hard limit to prevent token explosion
                                                let preview = &content; // GEMMA-4 262K UNLOCKED
                                                context.push_str(&format!("\n// === FILE: {} ===\n{}\n", path.display(), preview));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                cmd.push_str(&context);
                            }
                            
                            let state_clone = state.clone();
                            tokio::spawn(async move {
                                let _ = task_manager::send_task(
                                    state_clone.agent.clone(),
                                    &state_clone.client,
                                    &state_clone.api_key,
                                    &cmd,
                                    state_clone.memory.clone()
                                ).await;
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else => break,
        }
    }
}

async fn static_handler(uri: Uri) -> impl IntoResponse {
    let path = uri.path().trim_start_matches('/').to_string();
    let final_path = if path.is_empty() { "index.html".to_string() } else { path };
    match Assets::get(&final_path) {
        Some(content) => ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime_guess::from_path(&final_path).first_or_octet_stream().as_ref())], content.data).into_response(),
        None => if !final_path.contains('.') { ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html")], Assets::get("index.html").unwrap().data).into_response() } 
                else { StatusCode::NOT_FOUND.into_response() }
    }
}

async fn handle_read_file(Query(p): Query<FileParams>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    match sandbox::validate_path(&p.path) {
        Ok(safe) => match std::fs::read_to_string(&safe) {
            Ok(c) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(json!({ "content": c }))).into_response(),
            Err(_) => (StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "File not found").into_response(),
        },
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_write_file(Json(payload): Json<FileContent>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    match sandbox::validate_path(&payload.path) {
        Ok(safe) => {
            if let Some(p) = safe.parent() { let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(p); }
            match std::fs::write(&safe, &payload.content) {
                Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK.into_response(),
                Err(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.into_response(),
            }
        }
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

async fn handle_delete_file(Query(p): Query<FileParams>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    match sandbox::validate_path(&p.path) {
        Ok(safe) => {
            let res = if safe.is_dir() { std::fs::remove_dir_all(&safe) } else { std::fs::remove_file(&safe) };
            match res {
                Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK.into_response(),
                Err(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.into_response(),
            }
        }
        Err(_) => (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, Json(json!({"error": "Access Denied"}))).into_response(),
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize)] pub struct FileContent { pub path: String, pub content: String }
#[derive(Serialize)]   pub struct FsEntry      { pub name: String, pub path: String, pub is_dir: bool }
